{{Quote|If you had your way, you'd continue flying snubfighters and commanding fighter squadrons until you were a century old.|Ackbar, to Wedge Antilles|<ref name="Wraith Squadron">''[[X-Wing: Wraith Squadron]]''</ref>}}
'''Wedge Antilles''', a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]], was a famed [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] and [[General/Legends|general]], known as a hero of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] and [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. Orphaned at age seventeen, he joined the Rebellion after [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] forces [[Death/Legends|killed]] his girlfriend, [[Mala Tinero]]. A standout [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] pilot, he was one of the few to survive the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], after which he founded [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]] with his friend [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]]. Antilles and Skywalker built Rogue [[Squadron/Legends|Squadron]] into a renowned unit, and after the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]], Antilles took [[Rogue Leader/Legends|command]]. He flew as [[Red Leader/Legends|Red Leader]] in the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], striking the blow that destroyed the [[Death Star II/Legends|second Death Star]] alongside [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]] and becoming the only pilot to survive both [[Death Star/Legends|Death Star]] runs.

As the Rebel Alliance became the New Republic, Antilles continued to serve, gaining a reputation as a consummate [[Soldier/Legends|soldier]] and the New Republic's greatest pilot. He led Rogue Squadron in a covert mission to bring down [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant's]] [[Planetary shield/Legends|shields]], allowing the New Republic to [[Liberation of Coruscant (Galactic Civil War)|capture]] the [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]]. When denied permission to remove Imperial leader [[Ysanne Isard]] from power over [[Thyferra/Legends|Thyferra]], he resigned with his squadron and led a private [[Bacta War|guerrilla war]] that successfully toppled Isard. Accepted back into the New Republic, he formed [[Wraith Squadron]] as a [[Commando/Legends|commando]] unit and led it in [[Hunt for Zsinj|operations]] against the Imperial [[Warlord/Legends|Warlord]] [[Zsinj]].

In [[9 ABY/Legends|9 ABY]], Antilles accepted the promotion to general that his friend, [[Supreme Commander (Alliance)/Legends|Supreme Commander]] [[Gial Ackbar/Legends|Gial Ackbar]], had long desired for him. As a general, he reluctantly moved out of the [[Cockpit/Legends|cockpit]] and into a role in [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] operations, frequently commanding the [[Star Dreadnought/Legends|Star Dreadnought]] ''[[Lusankya/Legends|Lusankya]]''. During a [[Battle of Adumar|mission]] to the planet [[Adumar/Legends|Adumar]] in [[13 ABY/Legends|13 ABY]], he ignited a romance with [[Iella Wessiri Antilles|Iella Wessiri]], a friend in whom he had been interested for several [[Standard year/Legends|years]], and [[Marriage/Legends|married]] her after the mission's conclusion. They had two daughters, [[Syal Antilles|Syal]] and [[Myri Antilles|Myri]], as Antilles became [[Chief of Staff/Legends|Chief of Staff]] of [[New Republic Starfighter Command/Legends|New Republic Starfighter Command]] and then finally returned to command Rogue Squadron in [[18 ABY/Legends|18 ABY]]. In [[19 ABY/Legends|19 ABY]], after [[Pellaeon–Gavrisom Treaty|peace]] was achieved with the [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]], Antilles retired with more than twenty years of service to the Alliance and New Republic, ten as a general.

When the [[Yuuzhan Vong]] invaded the galaxy in [[25 ABY/Legends|25 ABY]], Antilles emerged from retirement, becoming the [[Commander/Legends|commander]] of New Republic [[Fleet Group Three]]. He participated in the failed [[Battle of Coruscant (Yuuzhan Vong War)|defense]] of Coruscant, then retreated to [[Borleias/Legends|Borleias]]. There he made a [[Battle of Borleias (Yuuzhan Vong War; Second)|stand]] against heavy opposition for several [[Standard month/Legends|months]] longer than expected and defeated the famed ex-[[Warmaster]] [[Czulkang Lah]], inspiring hope across the New Republic that the [[Yuuzhan Vong War|war]] against the invaders could be won. In [[29 ABY/Legends|29 ABY]], Antilles was one of the commanders in the [[Battle of Yuuzhan'tar|Recapture of Coruscant]] that ended the war.

He returned to retirement, but after being [[Prison/Legends|imprisoned]] by the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]], the New Republic's successor state, in the run-up to the [[Second Galactic Civil War]], Antilles escaped. He joined the forces of his [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]], [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]], as it revolted against the galactic government, reluctantly taking a side against his best friend, General [[Tycho Celchu/Legends|Tycho Celchu]], and his own daughter Syal, who had become a Galactic Alliance pilot. He served as the [[Supreme Commander of the Corellian Defense Force]], but he came to believe that the Corellian regime was itself corrupt and immoral. He resigned and instead offered his services to the [[New Jedi Order]], led by his lifelong friend Luke Skywalker. Skywalker formed a [[Jedi Coalition]] and, with Antilles's help, destroyed the [[Centerpoint Station|Centerpoint]] [[Superweapon/Legends|superweapon]] controlled by the Corellian [[Confederation]], then went on to defeat the Galactic Alliance's [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] leader, [[Darth Caedus]], and end the war. Afterward, Antilles retired for the third time, hoping to finally be able to live quietly with his [[Antilles family/Legends|family]].

==Biography==
===Youth===
====Boyhood====
{{Quote|When I was your age, I borrowed a Headhunter, that's a type of starfighter, from a friend, and used it to kill the men who were responsible for my parents' deaths. A deliberate act of revenge. The whole universe changed. All the things that had surprised or shocked or offended me just the day before became nothing, instantly.|Wedge Antilles, to Cheriss ke Hanadi|<ref name="Starfighters of Adumar">''[[X-Wing: Starfighters of Adumar]]''</ref>}}
A [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]], Wedge Antilles was born in [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], the son of [[Jagged Antilles]] and his wife [[Zena Antilles|Zena]], who owned a [[Fuel/Legends|fueling]] [[Gus Treta fueling station|depot]] in the [[Gus Treta Inner-System Market Station]] over the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]].<ref name="Major Character Birth Years" /><ref name="The Phantom Affair">''[[Star Wars: X-Wing Rogue Squadron: The Phantom Affair]]''</ref> He had a sister, [[Syal Antilles Fel|Syal]], who was ten [[Standard year/Legends|years]] older. She left Corellia while Antilles was only seven and lived estranged from her [[Antilles family/Legends|family]]. The Antilleses never had any word of her and spoke very little about her, but Wedge Antilles remained fond of the sister he never really knew.<ref name="Masquerade">''[[Star Wars: X-Wing Rogue Squadron: Masquerade]]''</ref><ref name="The Making of Baron Fel" /> He lived untouched by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the dissent rising against it.<ref name="Handbook 1">[[Star Wars Handbook 1: X-Wing Rogue Squadron|''Star Wars Handbook'' 1: ''X-Wing Rogue Squadron'']]</ref> Simpler concerns occupied his mind, such as his dream of living in [[Coronet City/Legends|Coronet City]], the glittering [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of Corellia. He had maps of the [[City/Legends|city]] projected onto the walls of his bedroom, and he longed to contribute to those maps himself by becoming an [[Architect/Legends|architect]] and building great structures.<ref name="Rogue Leader">''[[Star Wars: X-Wing: Rogue Leader]]''</ref><ref name="Mandatory Retirement">''[[Star Wars: X-Wing Rogue Squadron: Mandatory Retirement]]''</ref> At the same [[Time/Legends|time]], he was fascinated by [[Realspace/Legends|space]], and daydreamed of [[Navy/Legends|naval]] adventures.<ref name="Heir to the Empire Sourcebook">''[[Heir to the Empire Sourcebook]]''</ref>

Antilles split his time between a [[farm school]] located in Corellia's northern hemisphere and his [[Parent/Legends|parents]]' fueling depot on the Gus Treta [[Space station/Legends|station]]. At [[Farm/Legends|farm]] school, he received training in rural tasks along with his education. He learned to ride [[thak]]s and [[slopewing]]s, and from them herded [[Nerf/Legends|nerfs]] and [[nauga]]s. The other half of the year, Antilles traded pastoral pursuits for immersion in the world of spacegoing technology. Even as a [[Youngling/Legends|child]], he flew [[Spacetug/Legends|tugs]] and [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttles]] in busy [[Corellian system/Legends|Corellian space]].<ref name="Handbook 1" /> He worked as a [[Technician/Legends|mechanic]] as well and developed a great proficiency in repair as well as [[Pilot/Legends|piloting]].<ref name="The Phantom Affair" />

His family was friendly with [[Booster Terrik]], a noted Corellian [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]]. Terrik's daughter, [[Mirax Terrik Horn|Mirax Terrik]], was about Antilles's age, and she frequently stayed with the Antilles family when her father was on dangerous smuggling missions.<ref name="The Phantom Affair" /><ref name="Rogue Squadron">''[[X-Wing: Rogue Squadron]]''</ref> She and Antilles were close friends throughout their youth, calling each other by the respective childhood nicknames "Myra" and "Veggies."<ref name="The Phantom Affair" /> Antilles often put his talents to work assisting the smuggler in the upkeep of his [[Starship/Legends|ship]], the ''[[Pulsar Skate]]'', and sometimes even accompanied the Terriks on smuggling trips.<ref name="The New Essential Guide to Characters" /><ref name="The Phantom Affair" /> In return, Antilles learned many of Terrik's underworld tricks.<ref name="Wedge's Gamble">''[[X-Wing: Wedge's Gamble]]''</ref>

[[File:Young_Wedge.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Antilles watches his parents' deaths.]]
Just before his eighteenth [[Birthday/Legends|birthday]], a [[4 BBY/Legends|time]] when Antilles was in his last days of upper division school, the [[Bonestar Pirates]]' ship [[Buzzzer (starship)|''Buzzzer'']] under [[Loka Hask]] docked with the fueling station.<ref name="Galaxy Guide 1" /><ref name="The Phantom Affair" /><ref name="Handbook 1" /><ref name="Heir to the Empire Sourcebook" /> Antilles was aboard Booster Terrik's ''Pulsar Skate'' just off Gus Treta when the [[Corellian Security Force]] arrived. The ''Buzzzer'' fled the station without unhooking its fuel lines, starting a fire that threatened to destroy the station. Terrik established communications with Antilles's parents, and Antilles listened in horror as Jagged and Zena decided to [[Death/Legends|sacrifice]] themselves in order to reach the [[lancing charge]] that would separate the fueling module from the station, keeping the rest of Gus Treta from destruction. Antilles could do nothing but watch the destruction of the module and listen to his parents tell him goodbye.<ref name="The Phantom Affair" />

As Antilles grieved, Terrik's information sources revealed that the [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] had destroyed the station on purpose to cover their escape. Antilles asked Terrik for Hask's name, the location of the ship, and the use of a [[Z-95 Headhunter/Legends|Z-95 Headhunter]] [[Starfighter/Legends|fighter]].<ref name="The Phantom Affair" /> The two were able to track the ''Buzzzer'' to the [[Jumus system/Legends|Jumus system]].<ref name="Handbook 1" /> Though Terrik, aboard the ''Pulsar Skate'', urged Antilles to merely disable them and let the authorities deal with them, Antilles fired on the pirates from the Headhunter, destroying the ship and avenging his parents.<ref name="The Phantom Affair" /> The act immediately changed his outlook on life, forcing him into a hardened maturity.<ref name="Starfighters of Adumar" />

====On his own====
{{Quote|Wedge&hellip;when you come back, will you think about helping Dad? The Rebellion could really use you and your ship.''"<br />"''I admire what your father is doing. I do. But&hellip;''"<br />"''You just don't see what it has to do with you&hellip;|Mala Tinero and Wedge Antilles|<ref name="Lucky" />}}
Electing to live the life of a simple [[Merchant/Legends|trader]], Antilles struggled economically and had a hard time finding work, despite Terrik's aid in finding contacts.<ref name="The New Essential Guide to Characters" /><ref name="Lucky" /> He was unwilling to smuggle but unable to compete in a market where only smuggling paid enough to keep his small [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] in business.<ref name="Galaxy Guide 1" /> In his difficulties, he caught the [[Eye/Legends|eye]] of [[Car'das/Legends|Car'das]] syndicate [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]] [[Talon Karrde]], who once approached him with an offer to transport a cargo for him. Having heard no negative gossip about Karrde and therefore believing the man to be too unknown a quantity, Antilles declined.<ref name="The Bacta War" />

Antilles was orphaned but wealthy, left with the insurance payout on his parents and their depot as well as the [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] for killing the pirates.<ref name="Galaxy Guide 1" /><ref name="A New Hope Limited Wedge Antilles">{{CCG|set=A New Hope Limited|cardname=Wedge Antilles}}</ref> Though he had some surviving relatives, he did not stay with them.<ref name="Wedge's Gamble" /> With guidance from Terrik, he used the [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] to buy a tiny Corellian-made [[Wedge Antilles's freighter|freighter]], which he modified heavily and put to use as a legitimate pilot.<ref name="Galaxy Guide 1" /><ref name="The Phantom Affair" /><ref name="Lucky" />

[[File:WedgeFreighter-T23.jpg|thumb|right|200px|Antilles pilots his freighter from Gus Talon.]]
In [[2 BBY/Legends|2 BBY]], Antilles was operating from the Corellian [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Gus Talon/Legends|Gus Talon]]. There, he enjoyed the hospitality and services of [[Rallo]], an older man and mechanic who ran a garage, and fell in love with Rallo's daughter,<ref name="Lucky" /> [[Mala Tinero]].<ref name="EGTW">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref> Though Rallo was active in the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]], Antilles was uninterested in revolt against the Galactic Empire. Though he casually disliked the Empire and admired the Rebellion, he did not desire to get involved himself and did not find living under the Empire so objectionable.<ref name="Lucky" />

When Tinero asked Antilles once more to join the Rebellion and announced her own plans to join her father in resistance activity, Antilles grudgingly said he would consider it but put off further talk until he completed a delivery of machine parts, his first contract in [[Standard week/Legends|weeks]]. He would not get the chance to conclude the conversation, as he returned to find Gus Talon space in lockdown. Rallo's workshop had been raided and he and his workers had killed the Imperial [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] who threatened Tinero. In retaliation, the Empire had leveled the [[Gus Talon settlement|settlement]]. A pair of Imperial [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE/LN starfighters]] engaged Antilles as he attempted to land; outraged at the loss of Tinero, he instinctively unleashed his anger against the fighters, shooting them down. As more TIEs arrived, Antilles was forced to flee.<ref name="Lucky" />

Determined to find Tinero, he spent nine days waiting for the Imperial vigil over Gus Talon to end and hearing stories that the Empire had [[Bombing of Gus Talon|bombed]] the town and taken all survivors [[Prisoner/Legends|prisoner]]. Once Imperial forces withdrew, Antilles landed and investigated the town<ref name="Lucky" />&mdash;although Tinero had been killed,<ref name="CSWE Mala">{{CSWECite|II|278|Mala}}</ref> he was never able to determine her fate. Tinero's statement that he had been "lucky" when he got the contract wore on him, as he thought it tragic that he had not been there with Tinero.<ref name="Lucky" /> In the future, despite frequent accolades to his luck, Antilles never felt comfortable with the label "lucky," though he kept his private tragedy to himself and maintained that he had joined the Rebellion due to his inability to make a life as a legitimate freighter pilot.<ref name="Galaxy Guide 1" /><ref name="Lucky" />

====Rebel hotshot====
{{Quote|If I may answer a question with a question, how old were you before you first disagreed with a commanding officer&mdash;and later found out you were right?''"<br />"''Twenty. Which is when I first had a commanding officer.|Jagged Fel and Wedge Antilles|<ref name="Rebel Dream">''[[The New Jedi Order: Enemy Lines I: Rebel Dream]]''</ref>}}
Fired to battle the Empire, Antilles decided to join the nascent Rebel Alliance.<ref name="Lucky" /> With his experience as a freighter pilot and mechanic, he served as a gunrunner and proved an asset to the Alliance.<ref name="Galaxy Guide 1" /> His Alliance contacts hinted his skills could be even more valuable in the [[Cockpit/Legends|cockpit]] of a [[Space warfare/Legends|combat]] ship, and when the [[Alliance Starfighter Corps/Legends|Alliance Starfighter Corps]] put out an open call for pilots, Antilles enthusiastically joined the branch where he could strike directly against the Empire, as the Alliance was increasingly doing.<ref name="Handbook 1" /><ref name="Heir to the Empire Sourcebook" /> His first notable assignment was among the [[Tierfon Yellow Aces/Legends|Tierfon Yellow Aces]].<ref name="Lucky" /> [[Mala Tinero]].<ref name="EGTW" />

While on one patrol, Antilles happened across a secret [[Unidentified Imperial research facility|Imperial research facility]] where prototype [[TIE series/Legends|TIE]] models were tested. He reported his discovery to [[Alliance High Command/Legends|Alliance command]], and a lone [[BTL Y-wing starfighter/Legends|Y-wing]] was sent to obliterate a shipment of prototypes as they were being unloaded in a major coup for the young Rebellion.<ref name="X-Wing">[[Star Wars: X-Wing (video game)|''Star Wars: X-Wing'']]</ref>

Around [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]],<ref name="TFUDate">''[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II]]''{{'s}} [[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II (graphic novel)|''Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II'' comic]] dates its events, which include the [[assault on Kamino]], to approximately twelve [[Standard month/Legends|months]] before the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]]. ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' equates twelve months to a [[Standard year/Legends|year]], and establishes the year before the Battle of Yavin to be [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]].</ref> Antilles flew in a Y-wing [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] when he participated in both an orbital and ground [[Assault on Kamino|assault]] on Imperial [[Cloning/Legends|cloning]] [[Timira City|facilities]] on the planet [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]] led by the Rebel [[General/Legends|general]] and [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Rahm Kota/Legends|Rahm Kota]], together with [[Commodore/Legends|Commodore]] [[Yat-De Viedas]]. The [[Planetary shield/Legends|planet's shield]] proved stronger than expected, and the attack force suffered heavy losses attempting to breach it. After his squadron was torn apart by a concentrated blast of turbolaser fire, Antilles called for a retreat to be ordered. However, Kota commanded Antilles to hold his position and for all ships to keep pressing the attack. [[Subject 1138|Starkiller]], a clone of [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] Rebel leader [[Galen Marek]], whom Kota was mentoring, piloted the [[Salvation (flagship)|''Salvation'']] into the planet's [[Deflector shield generator/Legends|shield generator]]. Antilles piloted his Y-wing to the planet's surface, covering the [[Ground warfare/Legends|ground]] assault on the cloning facility. Starkiller leaped onto Antilles's fighter during the operation, asking the pilot to carry him to the cloning towers where the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]], Starkiller's former [[Sith Master/Legends|Master]], was holding Rebel [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Juno Eclipse/Legends|Juno Eclipse]]. Heavy fire kept Antilles from reaching it through the [[Starfighter combat/Legends|dogfight]], so at Starkiller's urging he dove underneath the platform on which the facility was built, then shot his way through the platform near the spires. He emerged near the target and Starkiller jumped into the building. There, Starkiller rescued Eclipse and managed to capture Vader, though Vader did not remain in Rebel custody long.<ref name="The Force Unleashed II novel">[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II (novelization)|''Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II'' novelization]]</ref>

Aboard [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]]<ref name="X-Wing" /> [[Gial Ackbar/Legends|Gial Ackbar's]] [[Mon Calamari Star Cruiser/Legends|cruiser]] the [[Independence/Legends|''Independence'']], Antilles served with [[Red Squadron (Rebel Alliance)/Legends|Red Squadron]]<ref name="IH:ACG">''[[Star Wars: Imperial Handbook: A Commander's Guide]]''</ref> in 1 BBY.<ref name="XWDate">The [[Battle of Turkana/Legends|Battle of Turkana]] takes place after the [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wing starfighter]] entered service with the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]], which ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'' places in [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]]. ''[[X-Wing: The Official Strategy Guide]]'' establishes that the [[Battle of Tatooine (Galactic Civil War)|capture of Leia Organa]] occurs at the end of [[Star Wars: X-Wing (video game)|''Star Wars: X-Wing'']]{{'s}} second tour of duty. Organa's capture takes place on 35:3:3 under the [[Great ReSynchronization]] dating system, placing it at the beginning of [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]] according to [[Template:YearMathGRS|the following explanation]]. Events in ''Star Wars: X-Wing'' before the end of the second tour of duty therefore take place in 1 BBY.</ref> In the [[Battle of Turkana/Legends|Battle of Turkana]], he notched three Imperial kills before he was forced to eject from his [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|T-65 X-wing starfighter]].<ref name="IH:ACG" />

Antilles was made a lieutenant in Red Squadron, and was listed among the squadron's key personnel as an active threat to the Empire in an edition of the ''[[Imperial Handbook: A Commander's Guide]]'' published shortly before the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]].<ref name="IH:ACG" /> Lieutenant Antilles flew as [[Red Two/Legends|Red Two]] under unit [[Commander/Legends|commander]] [[Garven Dreis/Legends|Garven Dreis]], [[Red Leader/Legends|Red Leader]].<ref name="A New Hope" /> Among the pilots in the unit whom Antilles befriended were [[Jek Tono Porkins/Legends|Jek "Piggy" Porkins]], the butt of many good-natured fat jokes, [[Cesi Eirriss|Cesi "Doc" Eirriss]], nicknamed for her [[Politics/Legends|political]] science [[Doctor/Legends|doctorate]],<ref name="X-Wing Rogue Squadron ½">[[X-Wing Rogue Squadron ½|''X-Wing Rogue Squadron'' ½]]</ref> and [[Jal Te Gniev]].<ref name="Vader's Quest">[[Vader's Quest 1|''Vader's Quest'' 1]]</ref> He quickly began flying in raids on Imperial [[Convoy/Legends|convoys]].<ref name="Fact File 48">{{FactFile|48|ANT 1-2|Wedge Antilles}}</ref> Though considered a show-off, Antilles was a standout pilot and emergent leader in the squadron, and so was quickly put in a position of responsibility.<ref name="Galaxy Guide 1" /><ref name="X-Wing Rogue Squadron ½" /><ref name="Rogue Squadron game">[[Star Wars: Rogue Squadron (video game)|''Star Wars: Rogue Squadron'']]</ref> He trained some junior pilots such as [[Bren Quersey/Legends|Bren Quersey]], was responsible for assigning starfighters to the unit's pilots, and was given command of some missions on which Dreis was not present.<ref name="X-Wing Rogue Squadron ½" /><ref name="Special Edition Limited Bren Quersey">{{CCG|set=Special Edition Limited|cardname=Bren Quersey}}</ref><ref name="Special Edition Limited Red 8">{{CCG|set=Special Edition Limited|cardname=Red 8}}</ref>

In [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], Red Squadron, stationed at the secret Rebel base in the [[Great Temple/Legends|Great Temple]] on [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]], a moon of the planet [[Yavin Prime/Legends|Yavin Prime]], was joined by a [[Ecliptic Evaders|squad]] of defectors from the Imperial ship [[Rand Ecliptic/Legends|''Rand Ecliptic'']], led by [[Biggs Darklighter/Legends|Biggs Darklighter]] and [[Derek Klivian/Legends|Derek "Hobbie" Klivian]].<ref name="Darklighter">''[[Star Wars: Empire: Darklighter]]''</ref> Antilles's first mission with Darklighter was a [[Imperial convoy raid|convoy raid]] in which Darklighter acquitted himself extremely well. Antilles greatly admired the defector's skills in the cockpit, and quickly became good friends with him.<ref name="Rogue Squadron" /> Antilles, Darklighter, and Porkins all came to room together on Yavin 4 and shared a strong camaraderie.<ref name="I, Jedi">''[[I, Jedi]]''</ref>

Late in 0 BBY, Antilles, along with most of the other pilots stationed on Yavin 4, was part of a [[Strike at an Incom Corporation facility|mission]] to strike an [[Incom Corporation/Legends|Incom Corporation]] facility and acquire several X-wing starfighters for the budding Rebellion. In a battle plan devised by General [[Jan Dodonna/Legends|Jan Dodonna]], Darklighter led his squad of TIE fighters to draw off the enemy fighter complement. Antilles and the other pilots landed at the facility on a [[Transport/Legends|transport]], quickly seized the advanced new fighters, and flew them back to the base on Yavin 4.<ref name="Darklighter" />

[[File:CommenorThugs-XWingRogueSquadron1-2.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Antilles faces down a street thug.]]
Shortly thereafter, Antilles commanded an [[Mission to Commenor (0 BBY)|undercover mission]] to the planet [[Commenor/Legends|Commenor]] for the purpose of acquiring smuggled [[R2-series astromech droid/Legends|R2-]] and [[R5-series astromech droid]]s for the new complement of fighters.<ref name="Darklighter" /><ref name="X-Wing Rogue Squadron ½" /> The group of Red Squadron pilots&mdash;Antilles, Darklighter, Eirriss, and Porkins&mdash;sneaked onto Commenor in the new X-wings, where they were supposed to play a game of [[Sabacc/Legends|sabacc]] in a particular [[Unidentified cantina (Commenor)|cantina]] until receiving instructions to meet their contact.<ref name="Darklighter" /> They played for some time, listening with great interest to news reports of the dissolution of the [[Imperial Senate/Legends|Imperial Senate]], until one of Antilles's cards, during sabacc's usual flux, altered to display a message to meet the smuggler at [[Hangar Bay 31]]. Outside the [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]], they encountered a group of thugs who attempted to shake them down for a protection fee on their rented [[Landspeeder/Legends|landspeeder]]. Taking exception to their fat jokes, the hefty Porkins started a fight with the toughs. Antilles and the others became involved in the brawl, and despite being heavily outnumbered, the Rebels came out the victors.<ref name="X-Wing Rogue Squadron ½" />

At the [[Hangar/Legends|hangar]] bay, Antilles met [[Nera Dantels]], the smuggler captain, and arranged to escort her to the Alliance with the shipment. On the way off Commenor, the Rebels were ambushed by fighters from a secret [[Folor Base (Imperial)|base]] on [[Folor]], Commenor's moon. The defeated thugs had spied upon their meeting and alerted the Empire. Antilles ordered Darklighter to engage the enemy fighters with him while Eirriss and Porkins covered Dantels's starship, the ''[[Starduster]]''. Antilles destroyed three fighters in the battle, and when Eirriss suffered damage to her fighter's [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]], he ordered her to transfer to the ''Starduster''. Eirriss insisted it would take too much time for her to transfer and the Rebels would be stopped. As Eirriss headed to engage another incoming wave of TIEs, Antilles reluctantly accepted the situation, and Eirriss instead plunged her damaged fighter into the formation of TIEs, taking most of the opposition with her.<ref name="X-Wing Rogue Squadron ½" />

====Victory at Yavin====
{{Quote|I remember the days before Yavin when we were all young, armored with the invincibility of youth and fired by the belief that the Emperor's evil Empire could not win. It didn't, but the cost was more horrible than any of us could have imagined.|Wedge Antilles|<ref name="The Bacta War" />}}
Soon after the pilots returned to Yavin, the Empire's planet-destroying [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|Death Star]] [[Superweapon/Legends|superweapon]] advanced on Yavin 4.<ref name="X-Wing Rogue Squadron ½" /> The base's pilots were quickly mustered for a briefing by General Dodonna. Antilles sat next to the newest Red Squadron pilot, [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]]&mdash;a friend of Darklighter who had, with the assistance of the legendary [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], [[Rescue of Princess Leia/Legends|rescued]] [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] from the Empire.<ref name="A New Hope" /> Skywalker took the place of Jal Te Gniev as [[Red Five/Legends|Red Five]], as Gniev was down with the [[measles]].<ref name="Vader's Quest" /> Organa, a Rebel leader from the world of [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] which had just been [[Destruction of Alderaan/Legends|destroyed]] by the Death Star's [[Superlaser/Legends|superlaser]], had obtained the [[Death Star plans/Legends|Death Star plans]], and from them Dodonna found a critical weakness. He told the assembled fliers that a [[Proton torpedo/Legends|proton torpedo]] fired down a [[Thermal exhaust port/Legends|thermal exhaust port]] that lacked [[Particle shield/Legends|particle shielding]] would cause a chain reaction that would destroy the enormous [[Battle station/Legends|battle station]]. Antilles voiced his skepticism that the two-[[Meter/Legends|meter]] target could be reliably struck while flying at full speed, under fire, down a trench in the station's surface, only to be reassured by Skywalker that the newcomer had hit targets of that size many times while bush piloting on his [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].<ref name="A New Hope" /> Antilles remained skeptical, considering the station's powerful defenses a difficult obstacle to overcome.<ref name="A New Hope novel">[[Star Wars: A New Hope (novelization)|''Star Wars Episode IV: A New Hope'' novelization]]</ref>

[[File:Wedge_Antilles.jpg|thumb|right|180px|Wedge Antilles in the cockpit during the Battle of Yavin]]
With only fifteen [[Standard minute/Legends|minutes]] until the Death Star rounded the [[Gas giant/Legends|gas giant]] Yavin and could fire on the moon Yavin 4, the Rebel fighter force was dispatched to battle the Empire's greatest weapon. Antilles, astounded at the space station's size, flew with the Reds as they engaged the station's surface defenses. He destroyed several defense [[Autoturret/Legends|turrets]] in the initial strafing runs, but Porkins was quickly killed, and when enemy TIEs emerged to dogfight, [[John D. Branon/Legends|John Branon]], who was flying as [[Red Four/Legends|Red Four]], was shot down immediately.<ref name="A New Hope" /><ref name="Apple Jacks Special">''[[X-Wing Rogue Squadron Special]]''</ref> When Skywalker was having difficulty evading a TIE tight on his tail, Antilles swooped in to destroy it in a bold head-to-head attack, adding to his high kill count of six enemy fighters over the course of the battle.<ref name="Galaxy Guide 1" /><ref name="A New Hope" />

After [[Gold Leader/Legends|Gold Leader]] [[Jon Vander/Legends|Jon Vander's]] trench run was foiled by Darth Vader piloting his [[TIE Advanced x1/Legends|TIE Advanced x1]], Dreis held Antilles, Darklighter, and Skywalker in reserve as he [[Theron Nett/Legends|and]] [[Puck Naeco/Legends|two]] [[Wingmate/Legends|wingmen]] made their own attempt. Dreis's wingmen were killed by Vader and his shot barely missed. Hotly pursued by Vader, he ordered the young pilots to make their own run on the exhaust port and was quickly killed by the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]]. Antilles and Darklighter hung back to cover the crack shot Skywalker as Vader and his wingmen again dropped on the trench runners from behind. Antilles took [[DS-61-3]]'s fire, which destroyed his [[Micro-maneuvering control/Legends|micro-maneuvering controls]].<ref name="A New Hope" /><ref name="A New Hope Limited Red 2">{{CCG|set=A New Hope Limited|cardname=Red 2}}</ref> As Antilles's [[Red Squadron 1|fighter]] was damaged to the point where he could no longer safely remain near the other fighters in the trench, Skywalker ordered him out. Antilles was left observing as Vader killed Darklighter but was disabled by the timely arrival of Skywalker's companions in the rescue of Organa, smugglers [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] and [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]]. With cover from their ship, the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']], Skywalker made the shot that destroyed the Death Star and saved the Rebel base.<ref name="A New Hope" />

In the wake of the Rebellion's crucial victory in the Battle of Yavin, the base's complement turned out to honor Skywalker, Solo, and Chewbacca for their heroism.<ref name="A New Hope" /> The victory was tinged with sadness, however, as Skywalker and Antilles were the only Red Squadron survivors from the battle.<ref name="Galaxy Guide 3 Second Edition">[[Galaxy Guide 3: The Empire Strikes Back (Second Edition)|''Galaxy Guide 3: The Empire Strikes Back'', Second Edition]]</ref> Antilles emerged with a reputation as a hot young pilot, however, and received medals himself as well. Antilles soon became fast friends with the budding [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] Skywalker and Solo, a fellow Corellian smuggler. Antilles also shared a camaraderie with less famous figures such as [[Finn Darktrin]], a Rebel agent who later was discovered to be an Imperial [[Spy/Legends|spy]], and [[Voren Na'al/Legends|Voren Na'al]], a Rebel [[Historian/Legends|historian]], [[Journalist/Legends|journalist]], and [[Propaganda/Legends|propagandist]].<ref name="Galaxy Guide 1" /><ref name="The Ruins of Dantooine">''[[Star Wars Galaxies: The Ruins of Dantooine]]''</ref>

The day after their victory at Yavin, the Rebels were alarmed to find a [[Carrack-class light cruiser/Legends|Carrack cruiser]] entering the [[Star system/Legends|system]]. Dodonna called a briefing including Antilles and Skywalker, with whom Antilles was already very friendly, to inform the pilot complement of this and forbid them from engaging it in the hopes that the Imperial ship would pass through the system without noticing the Rebel base. Solo, who disagreed with the orders, left the briefing and forced the ship down on Yavin 4. The Rebels dispatched its crew after a battle in which the captain, [[Skeezer]], was captured, keeping the base secure for a brief time more.<ref name="Assault on Yavin Four">''[[Star Wars Missions 1: Assault on Yavin Four]]''</ref> Nonetheless, the Empire soon learned of the battle and [[Yavin blockade|placed the system under blockade]].<ref name="Forces of Corruption">''[[Star Wars: Empire at War: Forces of Corruption]]''</ref>

Soon after the Death Star's destruction, Antilles was on patrol when a force under [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Tyber Zann]] entered the system, intent on retrieving data from the Death Star's wreckage. Antilles challenged him, but his patrol could not stop the [[Zann Consortium/Legends|Zann Consortium's]] superior force. He called for the Rebel picket to regroup, but before they could drive Zann from the system, an Imperial force emerged from [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] in hopes of enforcing the [[Blockade/Legends|blockade]]. The Rebels had to fight off this greater threat, and Zann was able to steal the data he sought and escape.<ref name="Forces of Corruption" />

===Rogue warrior===
====Forming Rogue Squadron====
{{Quote|My brother is a hero of the Rebellion.|Syal Antilles, to Soontir Fel|<ref name="The Making of Baron Fel" />}}
In Yavin's aftermath, Commander [[Arhul Narra/Legends|Arhul Narra]] of [[Renegade Flight]] was put in command of Red Squadron.<ref name="Galaxy Guide 3 Second Edition" /><ref name="General Skywalker">''[[Star Wars: Empire: "General" Skywalker]]''</ref> With an increasing core group of pilots flying independent missions with Antilles and Skywalker&mdash;Derek Klivian, a Red Squadron pilot who had been bedridden during the Battle of Yavin; Tierfon Yellow Aces pilot and expert [[Gunner/Legends|gunner]] [[Wes Janson/Legends|Wes Janson]]; veteran [[Zev Senesca/Legends|Zev Senesca]]; [[Sarkli]]; and [[Dak Ralter/Legends|Dak Ralter]], a new recruit&mdash;Skywalker and Antilles developed a new unit under Narra's guidance.<ref name="Rogue Squadron game" /><ref name="Galaxy Guide 3 Second Edition" /><ref name="Rebel Strike">''[[Star Wars: Rogue Squadron III: Rebel Strike]]''</ref> The pair co-founded [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Group]], also known as Rogue Squadron or Rogue Flight, as a subunit of Narra's squadron, with Skywalker serving as [[Rogue Leader/Legends|Rogue Leader]].<ref name="Galaxy Guide 3 Second Edition" /><ref name="Galaxy Guide 1 Second Edition">[[Galaxy Guide 1: A New Hope (Second Edition)|''Galaxy Guide 1: A New Hope'', Second Edition]]</ref> Primarily an X-wing squadron, they were known for an ability and willingness to use a variety of fighters as suited their mission profiles.<ref name="Rogue Squadron game" /><ref name="Shadows of the Empire Sourcebook">''[[Shadows of the Empire Sourcebook]]''</ref> Both Rogue and Renegade Flights eventually developed into full-strength squadrons, with Narra remaining the commander of both forces.<ref name="The Empire Strikes Back radio drama">[[The Empire Strikes Back (radio)|''The Empire Strikes Back'' radio drama]]</ref> The unit served as a highly independent elite squadron, having no permanent assignment so that it could be dispatched to whichever hotspot in which it was most needed.<ref name="Shadows of the Empire">[[Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire (novel)|''Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire'' novel]]</ref> Antilles made fast friends with his fellow pilots, especially Janson, with whom he shared interests in [[Alcohol/Legends|drinking]] and [[Gambling/Legends|gambling]], and whose skills as a pilot and gunner provoked Antilles's admiration. During his time as a Rogue, Antilles developed into a noted pilot, considered among the best in the Alliance.<ref name="Galaxy Guide 3 Second Edition" /> He devised the [[Antilles Maneuver/Legends|Antilles Maneuver]] to counteract legendary [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] starfighter tactician Admiral [[Adar Tallon/Legends|Adar Tallon's]] [[Tallon Roll/Legends|Tallon Roll]].<ref name="Special Edition Limited Antilles Maneuver">{{CCG|set=Special Edition Limited|cardname=Antilles Maneuver}}</ref>

Narra dispatched Antilles, Skywalker, Senesca, Solo, and Chewbacca to [[Reconnaissance mission to Kamino|investigate]] a secret Imperial [[Research City|research facility]] on the planet Kamino that recently had been abandoned. On their arrival over Kamino, they were ambushed by a group of [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] fighter pilots. The mercenaries chased Skywalker, Solo, and Chewbacca toward the planet, where the three were [[Tractor beam/Legends|tractored]] by a surface installation, along with the mercenaries. Antilles and Senesca were able to avoid being tractored, and when they detected no signs of life coming from the surface of the planet, they returned to Yavin 4 and reported the situation. Leia Organa led a rescue mission that found the three missing Rebels and [[Lune Oddo Divinian|Lune Divinian]], leader of the mercenaries, already escaping the planet.<ref name="Firefight">''[[Rebel Force: Firefight]]''</ref>

When the Rebellion ceased receiving shipments of metal from the planet [[Vactooine]], the Rebels feared there had been trouble with their allies at the [[Unidentified mining colony (Vactooine)|mining colony]]. Skywalker, Solo, Organa, and Chewbacca, as well as their [[Droid/Legends|droids]] [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] and [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] and the ancient [[mining droid]] [[Q-7N]], set out to [[Battle of Vactooine|investigate]] in the ''Millennium Falcon'', while Antilles and three fellow Rogues escorted them. There they found that an [[12-4C-41's Droid Army|army]] of rebellious droids, led by [[12-4C-41]] under the influence of criminal mastermind [[Olag Greck]], had seized the outpost. The Rebels convinced the droids to turn against Greck, foiling the plot.<ref name="The Vactooine Disaster">''[[Star Wars Missions 12: The Vactooine Disaster]]''</ref>

[[File:AntillesGnievCrashReaction-VadersQuest1.jpg|thumb|left|180px|Antilles looks on in horror as Jal Te Gniev drunkenly crashes an X-wing.]]
Two [[Standard month/Legends|months]] after the Battle of Yavin, Antilles's friend Jal Te Gniev was still devastated at having missed out on it, his place taken by the inexperienced farmboy who had become the Rebellion's greatest hero overnight. He became given to drink, muttering of how he should have been in Skywalker's place and deserved the youth's glory. Antilles found the older man drunk and belligerent in the halls of the Great Temple, and attempted to counsel him, only to be cut short by an alarm. Antilles and Te Gniev rushed to the hangar, where Skywalker's [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]] C-3PO explained that he had accidentally triggered the alarm. Te Gniev, still intoxicated, insensibly attempted to launch anyway. Antilles, shouting at him to stop, had to scramble out of the way as the bitter veteran clipped the side of the exit and plowed the expensive fighter into a [[Tree/Legends|tree]] outside. Te Gniev faced a military council, led by General Dodonna, that moved to transfer him to a recruiting position on [[Dubrava/Legends|Dubrava]], a backwater planet. Te Gniev, who denounced the council directly, emerged angry at his treatment, feeling he had been cast aside in favor of the "golden boy." Antilles, waiting outside for word, explained that Skywalker had personally asked the council for leniency. Te Gniev sarcastically thanked Skywalker before storming off.<ref name="Vader's Quest" /> He soon had a change of [[Heart/Legends|heart]], however, sacrificing himself to save Skywalker after he accidentally endangered a [[Mission to Jazbina|mission]] Skywalker undertook to the planet<ref name="Vader's Quest 4">[[Vader's Quest 4|''Vader's Quest'' 4]]</ref> [[Jazbina/Legends|Jazbina]].<ref name="Vader's Quest 2">[[Vader's Quest 2|''Vader's Quest'' 2]]</ref>

Eventually, the blockade of Yavin gave way to invasion as the Imperial forces [[Attack on Yavin 4|struck]] unexpectedly at the base. Under [[Orbital bombardment/Legends|bombardment]], the Rebels undertook an evacuation of the base they had previously saved. Antilles, Skywalker, and Sarkli flew together, shooting down enemy [[Landing craft/Legends|landing craft]] as the command staff attempted to evacuate. When the commanders were trapped inside the Great Temple by invading Imperial [[Troop/Legends|troops]], Antilles and Skywalker put down and rushed into the temple to save them. They shot their way through the stormtroopers and rescued Dodonna and his staff before making their way to the hangar. There, Sarkli saved them from a pair of [[All Terrain Scout Transport/Legends|All Terrain Scout Transports]], allowing the Rebels to make their escape. After the evacuation, the Rogues were assigned to [[Mission to Dantooine|pick up]] [[Tycho Celchu/Legends|Tycho Celchu]], an Imperial defector, on the planet [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]]. Skywalker and Sarkli rescued him from [[Storm commando/Legends|storm commandos]] who had captured him just as he attempted to defect. On his next [[Defense of Ralltiir|mission]] with Skywalker, Sarkli defected to the Empire.<ref name="Rebel Strike" /> Eventually, Celchu, a skilled TIE pilot, replaced Sarkli in Rogue Squadron.<ref name="The New Essential Guide to Characters" /> Antilles was initially distant from Celchu, as he was from many new pilots, fearing to get too close to them lest they die early. In time, however, the pair became inseparable friends.<ref name="In the Empire's Service">''[[Star Wars: X-Wing Rogue Squadron: In the Empire's Service]]''</ref>

====Rooting out a spy====
{{Quote|You are a ''long way'' from the family fueling depot, Wedge Antilles&hellip;|Antilles, reflecting in the middle of a firefight on the ''Devastator''|<ref name="2013SWcomic9">[[Star Wars (2013) 9|''Star Wars'' (2013) 9]]</ref>}}
Antilles, Skywalker, and Organa began flying missions to scout out potential locations for new bases, but consistently had their missions ruined by the appearance of Imperial forces.<ref name="2013SWcomic2">[[Star Wars (2013) 2|''Star Wars'' (2013) 2]]</ref> On one such [[Mission to Dominus III|mission]] to the planet [[Dominus III]] in the Outer Rim, Organa and Skywalker began discussing recent events after arriving, but Antilles interrupted them; he had spotted a Star Destroyer exiting hyperspace. The Star Destroyer immediately launched a squadron of [[TIE/IN interceptor/Legends|TIE interceptors]] and Antilles ordered the other two pilots, each flying X-wings, to make for the surface of Dominus III in an attempt to lose the enemy fighters. On the way in, Organa was shot down, taking a TIE with her; after hitting the ground, she climbed out of her damaged X-wing and shot and killed the [[Unidentified TIE/IN Interceptor pilot|TIE pilot]]. The three Rebels burned the downed TIE with an incendiary device to destroy its transponder. After Skywalker patched Organa's X-wing together, Antilles initially planned to spend the night on the planet, but soon discovered that the Imperials had sent TIE bombers out to search for the Rebels. Estimating that they only had a few minutes before being found, Antilles and the other two were forced to take off immediately, escaping the planet under cover of a polar storm and quickly making the jump to hyperspace.<ref name="2013SWcomic1">[[Star Wars (2013) 1|''Star Wars'' (2013) 1]]</ref>

Back on the Rebel [[EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate/Legends|Nebulon-B frigate]] [[Redemption/Legends|''Redemption'']],<ref name="2013SWcomic1" /> Antilles ran Skywalker through a simulator training session before they and six other pilots attended a secret meeting with Organa. Organa tasked the group with an off-the-record mission, classified [[deep black]], to root out the Imperial spy that High Command believed was sabotaging the Rebel missions, such as the one to Dominus III. Antilles was placed second in command to Organa. The group was assigned brand new X-wings painted black; when group member [[Falback Kord]] marveled at the new fighters, Antilles told him that Rebel leader [[Mon Mothma/Legends|Mon Mothma]] had spent a lot of money to obtain them and to take care of them.<ref name="2013SWcomic2" /> After a training mission, Antilles gave the other member of the group a tour of the new X-wings before Organa took the squad into space for more training. Once in space, Organa, needing to release some frustration, ordered Antilles alone to switch to a private channel, in which she arranged a heads-up dogfight between the two of them.<ref name="2013SWcomic3">[[Star Wars (2013) 3|''Star Wars'' (2013) 3]]</ref>

The secret group, internally designated as Gray Flight<ref name="2013SWcomic4">[[Star Wars (2013) 4|''Star Wars'' (2013) 4]]</ref> or [[Stealth Squadron]],<ref name="2013SWcomic12">[[Star Wars (2013) 12|''Star Wars'' (2013) 12]]</ref> then launched on a scouting mission to the [[Pybus system/Legends|Pybus system]], after Organa assigned Antilles to the same flight as herself. Upon arrival at the planet [[Pybus]], Gray Flight was surprised by an Imperial Star Destroyer plus an Interdictor cruiser. Unable to make for hyperspace due to the Interdictor's gravity well projectors, Antilles ordered his flight and flight two to make for the planet's surface, where he believed that the atmospheric cover would protect them from the Imperials' turbolasers. When the Imperials began orbital bombardment, however, he instead ordered the entire group to attack the Imperial ships at point-blank range, where they would be protected by the capital ships' own shields and by being inside the effective range of their main weapons. The Imperials responded by sending out two full squadrons of TIE interceptors. Corellian [[Tess Alder]], part of flight three, ignored an order from Organa to bug out and instead came toward the group, firing several proton torpedoes at the approaching cluster of enemy fighters.<ref name="2013SWcomic4" /> Antilles, knowing how the [[TIE pilot]]s would evade Alder's torpedoes, formulated a plan to box them in by having Organa assist him in launching their own torpedoes to either side of the TIEs; together, the two Corellians' plans eliminated eleven interceptors. Organa then created a plan to take out the Interdictor's gravity well projectors, ordering Antilles and Alder to form up behind her and acquire a torpedo target lock on her own emergency transponder. Antilles denounced the plan as "insane," but complied, firing torpedoes at his own squadron leader, who accelerated toward the Interdictor, then ejected her transponder directly in front of the gravity well projectors before breaking off. The torpedoes took out the gravity well projectors, enabling the Rebels to make an immediate escape into hyperspace.<ref name="2013SWcomic5">[[Star Wars (2013) 5|''Star Wars'' (2013) 5]]</ref>

Upon exiting hyperspace, however, they discovered that they had been followed by a TIE bomber, which quickly self-destructed in a kamikaze attack against Organa's fighter, severely damaging it and injuring Organa herself. Organa ordered Antilles and the rest of Gray Flight to get out of there and save themselves, but Antilles, along with Alder, argued against that course of action, saying that they would rather die wherever they were than leave Organa, who was crucial to the survival of the Rebellion, behind, and Organa yielded, thanking both of them for their concern for her.<ref name="2013SWcomic5" /> Knowing that they would be followed by the Star Destroyer, Antilles began moving the group, including Organa's damaged fighter, away from where they had reverted to realspace in an attempt to put enough distance between them and the Imperials to allow for a quick torpedo volley. They detected ships exiting hyperspace, but instead of Imperials, they were surprised to find<ref name="2013SWcomic6">[[Star Wars (2013) 6|''Star Wars'' (2013) 6]]</ref> the two members of Gray Flight who had been grounded back at the fleet for disciplinary reasons:<ref name="2013SWcomic3" /> Skywalker and [[Prithi]].<ref name="2013SWcomic6" /> Skywalker, who had earlier received a warning through the Force from Ben Kenobi that Organa was in danger, and Prithi, who was also Force-sensitive and thus had overheard the warning,<ref name="2013SWcomic4" /> had set out in violation of their grounding orders to save the Rebel leader.<ref name="2013SWcomic5" /> Antilles walked Skywalker, who had left his cockpit and spacewalked over to Organa's X-wing, through removing two fusion thrust reactors and attaching them to a manually armed proton torpedo, which was then pushed toward the Imperial capital ships as they arrived. The resulting blast obliterated the Star Destroyer and took a huge chunk out of the Interdictor, and the Rebels retreated into hyperspace.<ref name="2013SWcomic6" />

At the fleet, Antilles and Skywalker met with Mothma, who questioned them on why Organa, a critical Rebel leader, had gone on a mission that resulted in her having to be put into a bacta tank. Antilles pointed out that he didn't know the full details because the whole thing was classified on Mothma's own orders, and Mothma admitted that she knew everything and came to the realization that complete secrecy was no longer appropriate. She promoted Antilles from lieutenant to commander and Skywalker to a full lieutenant, and gave both of them security clearances sufficient to allow them to know everything that was going on. Antilles officially restored Skywalker and Prithi to active duty, and also requested and was granted permission from Mothma to move the squadron to the main hangars, giving them access to full support staff, since their cover had been blown by the manner in which they had returned.<ref name="2013SWcomic6" /> After Organa was out of the bacta tank, she briefed Skywalker on the problem with the spy, and Skywalker concocted a plan to find the mole from the other end by infiltrating<ref name="2013SWcomic7">[[Star Wars (2013) 7|''Star Wars'' (2013) 7]]</ref> the [[Devastator/Legends|''Devastator'']],<ref name="2013SWcomic8">[[Star Wars (2013) 8|''Star Wars'' (2013) 8]]</ref> the Star Destroyer of Imperial Colonel [[Kell Bircher|Bircher]], who was leading the forces the spy was believed to be reporting to. Soon after, Antilles found himself on a shuttle with Skywalker as they arrived at Bircher's fleet. Along for the ride was Prithi, who detached her stealth X-wing from the shuttle and attached it to the ''Devastator'' as the shuttle was pulled into its docking bay.<ref name="2013SWcomic7" />

On board the ''Devastator'', Antilles and Skywalker were placed in handcuffs as Bircher ordered them to be detained at maximum security. Placed in a cell, Antilles turned to his companion for escape ideas. Skywalker had concealed his [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]], partially disassembled, in his boot and slipped it past the guards [[Mind trick/Legends|using]] [[The Force/Legends|the Force]]. After reassembling the Jedi weapon, Skywalker used it to cut their way out of the cell and take out a [[KL-443|lone stormtrooper]] guarding the detention area. Antilles then used the stormtrooper's blaster to destroy the locks in the cell bay, freeing several other prisoners to provide a distraction while the two Rebels headed for the data core facility to insert a worm into the system.<ref name="2013SWcomic8" /> With both Rebels now armed&mdash;Skywalker having also obtained a blaster&mdash;they proceeded through the ship. Approaching the computer junction, they were surprised by a squad of stormtroopers; after Skywalker beat back the initial attack, Antilles went to the computer to do his work while Skywalker continued holding them off.<ref name="2013SWcomic9" /> After completing the task, Antilles and Skywalker found a TIE interceptor hangar, hid in a pair of cockpits, and began discussing whether Prithi, whom they were unable to contact, would have left; Antilles noted Skywalker's apparent feelings for Prithi, and the continuing discussion prompted Antilles to remember his late girlfriend, Tinero.<ref name="2013SWcomic10">[[Star Wars (2013) 10|''Star Wars'' (2013) 10]]</ref>

Prithi had in fact left and made it back to the Rebel fleet, but her life support system had failed and she was near death. She had also been tracked by Bircher, who, now knowing the location of the Rebels, soon followed with the ''Devastator''. Upon the ''Devastator''{{'s}} arrival, the entire wing of TIEs that Antilles and Skywalker were hiding in was scrambled, and the two Rebels launched as well, with Antilles instructing Skywalker to blend in.<ref name="2013SWcomic10" /> Upon receiving orders from Bircher, who was personally leading the wing, to attack their own fleet, Antilles and Skywalker engaged the afterburners on their interceptors, streaking away from the Imperials and dodging Rebel fire until they crash-landed into ''Home One''{{'s}} hangar and revealed their identity by popping out of the hatches. Quickly transferring to X-wings, Antilles and Skywalker were asked by Organa to take the lead in the dogfight; Antilles quickly briefed the squadron on what they were facing before they entered the fight. After some brief combat, Antilles was surprised to receive new orders from ''Home One'', instructing him an all other Rebel pilots to stand down and let the Imperials go. He initially refused, desiring revenge for everyone that had been killed at Yavin, but Organa convinced him to comply.<ref name="2013SWcomic11">[[Star Wars (2013) 11|''Star Wars'' (2013) 11]]</ref>

The reason why soon became clear: Bircher contacted Mon Mothma directly, gave her the override codes for the ''Devastator'' and the TIEs, and landed his own fighter in a hangar on ''Home One'',<ref name="2013SWcomic11" /> where he revealed himself to be the spy&mdash;but one working on behalf of the Alliance, not the Imperial spy that Stealth Squadron had been searching for and in fact didn't exist. The entire Stealth Squadron mission had been a scam to retrieve Kell Bircher, Mothma's nephew. Antilles, along with Skywalker, were present in Mothma's chamber a short time later, seeking answers. Mothma explained that she and her nephew had come up with the plan in infiltrate the Imperials before the Battle of Yavin, and that no one other than them and a [[Unidentified Bothan slicer|Bothan slicer]] who had set up his fake history. Antilles wanted to know if Bircher had had any safeguards in place when those under his command had been attacking the Rebels; the spy answered that he had, the entire time, kept his thumb on the same override switch that he had used to end the battle, a response that Antilles was content with.<ref name="2013SWcomic12" />

Antilles then informed Mothma that he had logged an official request in the system to disband Stealth Squadron and form a new, official squadron under his command, stating that he preferred a straight fight to sneaking around. He proposed the name "Rogue Squadron"<ref name="2013SWcomic12" />&mdash;a name that he had discussed with Skywalker back in their TIE cockpits on the ''Devastator'', likening the term "rogue" to the word "rebel,"<ref name="2013SWcomic10" />and said that any of the Stealth pilots were welcome to join the new squadron, as well as Bircher. Mothma gave her approval for the squadron, but said that Bircher was needed back on his homeworld of [[Chandrila/Legends|Chandrila]]. Later, Antilles briefed the former Stealth pilots; he informed them that the TIE interceptors that had been captured with Bircher's override codes were being checked for tracking devices, but after that they would become theirs to play with first. He told them about Rogue Squadron and invited all of them to join before setting a challenge: the first pilot to match his score from his Imperial pilot's test in one of the captured TIEs would become his executive officer in Rogue Squadron.<ref name="2013SWcomic12" />

Following Organa's decision to marry Prince [[Kaspar]] of [[Arrochar]] in exchange for the Alliance's use of the remote planet as a safe harbor, Antilles, as Rogue Leader, escorted a shuttle carrying Arrochar negotiators to ''Home One'', where arrangements for the Rebel haven were finalized and the pilot proposed a starfighter training program for the planet's populace. On Arrochar, Skywalker chafed under Antilles' command, and his erratic behavior and reckless flying during a ground-following exercise drove the squadron leader to ground him,<ref name="2013SWcomic15">[[Star Wars (2013) 15|''Star Wars'' (2013) 15]]</ref> while the Arrochar pilots in his training program resented the need to use outdated Z-95 Headhunter starfighters. Antilles raised concern at both issues in conversation with the Princess,<ref name="2013SWcomic16">[[Star Wars (2013) 16|''Star Wars'' (2013) 16]]</ref> who had taken him as a confidant, privy to her frustration at the reactions of her fellow Rebels to her coming marriage.<ref name="2013SWcomic15" /> However, the wedding was disrupted by a [[Bomb/Legends|bombing]], marking the betrayal of the Alliance to the Empire by their supposed Arrochar allies. Leaving the ceremony, Antilles scrambled to his X-wing and joined the rest of Rogue Squadron, already in the air, in [[Battle of Arrochar|battle]] against Imperial and Arrochar forces. Though the attack was repulsed, the Alliance had lost their new base, and fled Arrochar into hyperspace.<ref name="2013SWcomic18">[[Star Wars (2013) 18|''Star Wars'' (2013) 18]]</ref>

It was not long before the Rebels were once more established on Yavin 4, sneaking back to reoccupy their old base.<ref name="Darth Vader's Return">''[[Star Wars Missions 17: Darth Vader's Return]]''</ref> There, they were again found out and encircled with an Imperial blockade.<ref name="Race for Survival">"[[Race for Survival]]"</ref> Rogue Squadron was [[Mission to Kwenn Space Station|dispatched]] to [[Kwenn Space Station/Legends|Kwenn Space Station]], in orbit around the planet [[Kwenn/Legends|Kwenn]], to search for tips on poorly-traveled [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlanes]] that might provide suitable locations for another hidden Rebel base.<ref name="Darth Vader's Return" /> There, Antilles learned that the Empire had been interfering with many of the formerly safe trade routes to stifle the Rebellion's mobility in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]]. When he observed the Empire seizing the [[Action VI bulk transport/Legends|Action VI transport]] ''[[Stellar Manx]]'' without explanation, it aroused his suspicion. He dispatched a [[message drone]] to Organa, who was herself scouting [[Malagarr/Legends|Malagarr]], reporting the oddity and requesting her aid as he, Janson, and Celchu investigated. The trio puzzled over what the Imperials were doing with the ''Stellar Manx'', Antilles surmising that they simply wanted to seize it to replace their losses in cargo capacity at Yavin. They were surprised by a trio of stormtroopers, whom they outfought. The Rogues were able to rescue [[Kar Lamoran]], the ''Stellar Manx''{{'s}} captain, and recapture the freighter after the Imperials tried to escape in it. They discovered and reported that the operation had been carried out at [[Darth/Legends|Darth]] Vader's orders, and the ship had been destined for the planet [[Bonadan/Legends|Bonadan]]. Solo and Organa followed up on the tip, taking over the effort of foiling Vader's plot.<ref name="Rogue Squadron to the Rescue">''[[Star Wars Missions 18: Rogue Squadron to the Rescue]]''</ref>

====Plague on Gobindi====
{{Quote|Test cases. They're using the city to see how effective the blobs are, I'd guess. We're all lab rats.|Wedge Antilles, to Tash Arranda|<ref name="Planet Plague">''[[Galaxy of Fear: Planet Plague]]''</ref>}}
[[File:Wedge_GG1.png|thumb|right|180px|Antilles in 0 ABY]]
[[Mission to Gobindi|Dispatched]] to the world [[Gobindi]] with three other Rebels, Antilles intended to spend only a few days there investigating the [[Mah Dala Infirmary]], which was suspected of being a front for the [[Imperial Biological Weapons Division]]. He was trapped for three weeks when the Empire began [[Blockade of Gobindi|blockading]] the planet on the pretense of heavy pirate activity in the area, and labeled the four Rebel [[operative]]s as wanted pirates. Around the same time, several strange [[blob]] creatures began emerging from the forest. The Rebels suspected a connection.<ref name="Planet Plague" />

Antilles was outside the Mah Dala Infirmary in the planet's sole city [[Mah Dala]]&mdash;consisting entirely of buildings perched atop massive [[Ziggurat/Legends|ziggurats]] projecting from the world's fierce jungle&mdash;when one of the blob creatures attacked a droid that was with a young girl. He rushed to peel the blob off the droid, but it began creeping up his [[Limb/Legends|arms]]. With the droid's aid, he was able to drop it over the railing of the ziggurat. Antilles then introduced himself to the girl, [[Tash Arranda/Legends|Tash Arranda]], and the droid, [[DV-9]]. He offered them a tour of the city, and in conversation found that Arranda seemed to have anti-Imperial sympathies, though she had arrived during the blockade&mdash;an action accomplished only by Imperials. When Arranda mentioned that her brother, [[Zak Arranda/Legends|Zak Arranda]], was in the [[Medcenter/Legends|hospital]] due to an illness, Antilles felt he could trust her, and revealed that no one had left the Mah Dala Infirmary alive recently. At that moment, a squad of stormtroopers rushed to the [[Unidentified Gobindi plaza|plaza]] in which they were speaking and arrested [[Unidentified Rodian Rebel|one]] of the other Rebels, a [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]], on grounds of piracy. Antilles slipped away to avoid capture himself.<ref name="Planet Plague" />

He gathered his remaining compatriots and entered Arranda's ship, the [[Shroud (starship)|''Shroud'']], after trailing her there. He asked for her help in getting offworld with whatever clearance codes had gotten them past the blockade originally. Arranda proved to be friendly to the Rebellion, but before she made a decision [[Unidentified Human Rebel|one]] of the other Rebels was attacked by another blob. They pulled it away, but the man fell ill immediately, leading them to deduce that the creatures were carriers of the bioengineered [[Influenza necrosi|malady]] the Imperial [[Scientist/Legends|scientists]] were developing. Antilles took the man back to their [[Unidentified Rebel safehouse (Gobindi)|safehouse]] with a last request for Arranda to help them escape.<ref name="Planet Plague" />

After giving their companion aid, Antilles and the [[Unidentified Bothan Rebel|last]] Rebel, a [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]], returned to staking out the ''Shroud''. When Zak Arranda and DV-9 arrived, saw the slime trail, and followed it down the ziggurat and into the jungle thinking Tash Arranda had been abducted by a blob, the Rebels hurried to follow them. The boy and the droid were cut off from ascending the ziggurat by a swarm of blobs, causing them to flee. Antilles and the Bothan gave chase, and shot the blobs off the unarmed pair when they were cornered. DV-9 found a door into the nearby ziggurat, which warned in [[Gobindi language|Gobindi script]] that a virus was locked within. From it, they were surprised to see Tash Arranda, her and Zak's "uncle" [[Mammon Hoole]], and Doctor [[Kavafi]]&mdash;the head of the infirmary who had been replaced by the bioweapon designers&mdash;emerge. Hoole, a [[Shi'ido]] [[Changeling/Legends|shapeshifter]], transformed himself into a [[mammoth frog]] and leaped the beleaguered individuals to safety atop the ziggurat. With information from the ziggurat inscriptions, Kavafi was able to manufacture a cure, defeating the [[Project Starscream|virus project]]. Antilles piloted the ''Shroud'' past the Imperial blockade and returned to the Rebel base.<ref name="Planet Plague" />

====Escape from Yavin====
{{Dialogue|Dodonna|You have your orders, Commander. Get that last transport your flight is escorting to the rendezvous ''immediately''! ''I'll'' see the Empire doesn't ''follow'' you!|Antilles|Luke! What's General Dodonna ''talking'' about? What's he going to ''do''?!|Skywalker|From his remarks about his ''health'' failing since the death of his ''son'', Wedge&hellip;I'm afraid he's chosen to ''retire''&hellip;in a way that will take those Imperial attackers ''with'' him!|attr=Jan Dodonna, Wedge Antilles, and Luke Skywalker|src=<ref name="Race for Survival" />}}
When Darth Vader brought his mammoth [[Executor-class Star Dreadnought/Legends|Star Dreadnought]] [[Executor/Legends|''Executor'']] to Yavin for a final strike at the Rebellion six months after the Battle of Yavin, the Rebels were forced to [[Evacuation of Yavin|evacuate]] the base for good. Skywalker and [[Vrad Dodonna]], the son of General Dodonna, departed on a [[Skirmish in the Feswe Corridor|mission]] to breach the ''Executor''{{'s}} [[Deflector shield/Legends|shields]] with a [[power gem]] before it could reach the [[Yavin system/Legends|Yavin system]]. With backup from Han Solo, they were able to cripple the ship's control systems, buying the Rebellion more time to evacuate. Antilles oversaw the fighter escort for the [[GR-75 medium transport/Legends|evacuation transports]], which came under attack sooner than expected when Vader ordered blockade commander Admiral [[Amise Griff]] to proceed with the assault without the ''Executor''. As the transports left, Dodonna, distraught at the death of his son in the attack, stayed behind to detonate [[concussion charge]]s that decimated the attacking fighters. He was assumed killed in action.<ref name="Race for Survival" />

The Rebel [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] rendezvoused out of the immediate grasp of Griff's forces, but still within the blockade. A Mon Calamari fleet under Admiral Ackbar provided a surprise [[Battle of the Vallusk Cluster|attack]] on the blockade forces at multiple points, hoping to draw Griff out of position, but the canny admiral found the Rebels' hoped escape route and cut it off. Solo scouted another, which was blocked by unpredictable [[Star/Legends|stellar]] flares. Skywalker had to call on his knowledge of the Force to guide the fleet through a safe route, narrowly missing an ambush by the ''Executor''.<ref name="Race for Survival" />

[[File:IsonAmbush-RSII.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Antilles and Skywalker fly in the ambush in the Ison Corridor.]]
Escorting the convoy, destined for the new [[Safe world/Legends|safeworld]] [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]], through the [[Ison Trade Corridor/Legends|Ison Corridor]], they came out of hyperspace in the debris of a previous convoy. The Rebel ships had to pick their way through the debris field and a nearby [[Nebula/Legends|nebula]] before they could reenter hyperspace, but before they could do so they were [[Ison Corridor ambush|set upon]] by the Imperial force that had destroyed the first squadron of transports. Unable to keep up with the enemy TIEs as they tore into the convoy, Antilles suggested he and Skywalker transfer to the new [[RZ-1 A-wing interceptor/Legends|A-wing interceptors]]. They docked with the Nebulon-B frigate ''Redemption'' and transferred. In the new, speedy [[Interceptor/Legends|interceptors]], they were able to ward off the TIE attackers. In the nebula, they held off TIE Interceptors, allowing the transports to proceed safely to Hoth.<ref name="Rogue Leader game">''[[Star Wars: Rogue Squadron II: Rogue Leader]]''</ref>

The Hoth base would not be ready for occupancy for another two years, however, and the Rogues operated elsewhere. They trained briefly on the planet Tatooine, during which period Skywalker and Antilles, out for a morning flight, noticed the Empire [[Ambush at Mos Eisley|bombing]] [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]] in retaliation for the smuggling activity based out of the [[Spaceport/Legends|starport]]. They struck against the Imperial [[TIE/sa tactical bomber/Legends|TIE/sa bombers]], saving the city from annihilation. The Rogues moved on to further missions, escorting a supply convoy that came under [[Rendezvous on Barkhesh|attack]] on [[Barkhesh/Legends|Barkhesh]] and finding and [[Search for the Nonnah|rescuing]] the crashed Rebel ship ''[[Nonnah]]'' on the planet [[Chorax]], holding off Imperial forces that attempted to seize the freighter's personnel and captured supplies.<ref name="Rogue Squadron game" />

====Betrayal in the Poln system====
{{Quote|That's Antilles for you&mdash;flies as crazy as Solo does.|Colonel Airen Cracken, on Antilles's flying|<ref name="Choices of One">''[[Choices of One]]''</ref>}}
Later, the Rebels were approached through [[Alderaanian/Legends|Alderaanian]] [[Vestin Axlon]] by [[Governor/Legends|Governor]] [[Bidor Ferrouz]] of [[Candoras sector/Legends|Candoras sector]] with an offer. Ferrouz, who claimed to harbor Rebel sympathies, proposed that the Alliance use abandoned mines and caverns on the planet of [[Poln Minor]] as a base in return for protection against the mysterious<ref name="Choices of One" /> [[Storm-hair]]<ref name="Crisis of Faith">{{StoryCite|story=Crisis of Faith|book=Heir to the Empire: The 20th Anniversary Edition}}</ref> warlord [[Nuso Esva]]. While Axlon, Solo, Chewbacca, and Skywalker [[Battle for Poln Major|headed]] for the sector's capital planet [[Poln Major]], located in the [[Poln system/Legends|same system]], to meet Ferrouz and discuss terms with him, an advance scouting team, including Antilles, Rogue Squadron, Colonel [[Airen Cracken/Legends|Airen Cracken]], and Organa, was sent to Poln Minor to evaluate the area and check things out. While exploring a system of caverns, Antilles was surprised to run into Solo and Chewbacca, who had been ordered to remain on Poln Major. Antilles called Cracken over to report their presence.<ref name="Choices of One" />

[[File:Wedge_Antilles_by_Jason_Palmer.jpg|thumb|Wedge Antilles after one of many missions]]
The offer was not as it seemed, though; Ferrouz was in fact a loyal Imperial whose family had been kidnapped by agents of Esva, who in turn had given the governor a list of demands that included the "deal" with the Rebels. Furthermore, Axlon planned to kill Ferrouz in an act of revenge for the destruction of Alderaan, but the renegade stormtrooper unit known as the [[Hand of Judgment]] stopped and killed him before he could carry out the murder. Solo and Organa were talked into helping mount [[Caldorf VII interceptor missile|missiles]] on attack ships, though they didn't know it was for Esva's people; eventually they were forced to flee through unfamiliar tunnels in a [[Speeder bus/Legends|speeder bus]]. Cracken established contact with them and told them to turn into a side tunnel; Antilles and two other pilots in X-wings flew the other way down the side tunnel and past the bus to look for Solo and Organa's pursuers, but were unable to find any sign of them or the cavern where the missiles were being installed.<ref name="Choices of One" />

At a meeting aboard Cracken's transport, Antilles reported his failure, though after reviewing what she had observed, Organa was able to locate the main cavern through deductive reasoning, so Cracken began planning an attack on it. Since X-wings were too large for the tunnel they would have to use, Antilles proposed using the new [[T-47 airspeeder/Legends|T-47 airspeeders]] that the Rebels had obtained on Poln Minor earlier in the mission. Cracken objected on the basis that the T-47s weren't armed as well as the X-wings, but Antilles dismissed that, pointing out that firepower was a secondary concern to getting there in the first place and that the Rebels would have the element of surprise. After a moment, the Colonel agreed to the plan.<ref name="Choices of One" />

As they prepared for the attack, Antilles told Organa that she did not have to go with them, but she insisted on riding with him anyway. With Organa in the gunner's seat of Antilles's T-47, the Rogues took off. Upon arriving at the cavern and beginning attack runs, Antilles and the other Rebels were surprised to find the missile ships operational, ready to fly, and firing back. Outnumbered fifty to ten and outgunned as well, Antilles began attack runs anyway. As he flew and Organa fired on the ships, they realized that the T-47s' firepower wasn't enough to get through the missile ships' armor and shields.<ref name="Choices of One" />

Suddenly, Cracken came over the comm and ordered the Rogues to break off the attack and return to the staging point. Antilles requested confirmation, and when that was provided, recommended against that, but Cracken told them that Solo had other plans. On their way out, at Organa's request, Antilles ordered Rogue Three to pull alongside him. Organa attached a harpoon cable to Rogue Three, and Antilles maneuvered so that the cable took off a sensor bulb on one of the missile ships. Antilles ordered the Rogues to leave, and the other pilots and gunners repeated the trick on the way out. Antilles and the Rogues got out of the cavern just before Esva's people blew the roof of the cavern to allow the ships to take off. Solo, who had bluffed his way onto the [[Golan I Space Defense Platform/Legends|Golan I defense platform]] orbiting Poln Major, had the platform's commander, [[Barcelle]], order his men to fire all of their proton torpedoes in the direction of the ships, which destroyed them all.<ref name="Choices of One" />

The Imperials, with the help of the seven ships of [[Death Squadron/Legends|Death Squadron]], won the ensuing [[Battle of the Poln system|battle]] against Esva's [[Eastern Fleet]], while the Rebels escaped with plenty of war materiel, including the T-47s. Later, back at base, Antilles was seen with Skywalker and Organa as the latter was talking to the two men.<ref name="Choices of One" />

====Scattered battles====
Soon after the evacuation, Antilles was stationed on the planet [[Thila/Legends|Thila]].<ref name="Galaxy Guide 1" /> When [[Thila Command|the Rebel base]] there was discovered by the Empire, the Rogues scrambled to cover while an evacuation was prepared. Antilles quickly launched in his T-47 airspeeder, on which Chewbacca had been working.<ref name="The New Essential Guide to Characters" /> Though Antilles was friends with Chewbacca, he did not understand [[Shyriiwook/Legends|Shyriiwook]] and did not understand Chewbacca's warning that the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] was still repairing the ship. He took off with Chewbacca dangling from the [[Airspeeder/Legends|airspeeder's]] belly, his hands in an access hatch. After a TIE pilot displayed confusion upon seeing the Wookiee, Antilles had Wes Janson perform a visual check and was horrified to learn that Chewbacca was precariously caught in a high-altitude [[Battle of Thila|dogfight]]. Han Solo, who had been informed by the other mechanics, contacted him by [[Comm unit/Legends|comm]] and insisted that Antilles match velocity over another airspeeder and let Chewbacca climb down, but Antilles did not think he could spare the time for another Rogue to exit the battle. He slipped over a TIE, allowing Chewbacca to commandeer the fighter and return to base. Once the battle was over, Antilles spent some time hiding atop a suspended cargo crate, avoiding the Wookiee's wrath.<ref name="Chewbacca">[[Star Wars: Chewbacca (2000)|''Star Wars: Chewbacca'' (2000)]]</ref> Despite Antilles's misadventure, the Rogues' performance at the evacuation of Thila proved that they were a highly effective team of pilots, gaining them greater respect within the Alliance hierarchy.<ref name="Trilogy Sourcebook Special Edition">''[[Star Wars Trilogy Sourcebook, Special Edition]]''</ref>

Seven months after the Battle of Yavin, Antilles, Skywalker, Arhul Narra, and Zev Senesca were sent to [[Battle of Lubang Minor (Galactic Civil War)|escort]] a unit of [[Alliance Intelligence/Legends|Alliance Intelligence]] agents tasked to set up a [[Listening post/Legends|listening post]] on [[Lubang Minor]]. While the Intelligence personnel set up their equipment, Skywalker explored the jungle, only to rush back with news that he had discovered graves and a crashed Clone Wars&ndash;era [[Low Altitude Assault Transport/infantry/Legends|LAAT/i]] transport. As he reported this, an Imperial landing force arrived and attacked. Antilles and Senesca were able to launch their X-wings, but Skywalker and Narra were trapped on the ground.
