Antilles and Senesca handled the TIEs, with Antilles shooting one down just as it was about to strafe Narra and Skywalker. Increased TIE reinforcements, however, drove the pilots to [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]]; unable to take on that many starfighters, they retreated to the other side of the planet from the Imperial [[Capital ship/Legends|capital ship]] launching the fighters. With the aide of a [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] who had been stranded on the planet since the Clone Wars, [[Able|BL-1707]], nicknamed "Able," those left on the ground were able to escape, and the Rebels slipped away.<ref name="General Skywalker" />

[[File:WedgeAndHobbiePwnTIEs-E34.jpg|thumb|right|200px|Wedge Antilles and Derek Klivian engage TIE fighters over Jabiim.]]
Soon after, the [[Jabiimi Loyalists|Jabiimi Loyalist]] leader [[Nolan Gillmunn]] requested Alliance aid to his cause as he battled the Empire's control of [[Jabiim/Legends|Jabiim]], exercised through the [[Jabiimi Nationalists|Jabiimi Nationalist party]]. The Rebels sent a [[Diplomat/Legends|diplomatic]] party consisting of Leia Organa, Skywalker, and statistician [[Jorin Sol]], transported by Nera Dantels aboard the ''Starduster''. Antilles and Derek Klivian escorted them and remained in orbit as backup while the others landed on the planet Jabiim. Once the Loyalists heard that the Alliance had sent Luke Skywalker, the son of Anakin Skywalker, as a representative, they were furious and ordered Antilles and Klivian to depart Jabiim planetary space. Anakin Skywalker had been ordered off the planet over two decades ago by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], when it had been supporting the Loyalists against the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] Nationalists, and as the symbol of their deprivation of aid in their [[Standard hour/Legends|hour]] of greatest need the Loyalists hated him virulently. As Klivian and Antilles debated what to do next, they were attacked by TIEs aligned with the Nationalist government. The pair of Rogue pilots fled, unsure if killing more [[Jabiimi]] would inflame the diplomatic situation with the others on the ground. They ran into an Imperial fleet arriving to [[Subjugation of Jabiim|capture]] the Rebels&mdash;sold out by disillusioned Loyalist [[Tal Hesz]]&mdash;and [[Slavery/Legends|enslave]] the Jabiimi, and decided they had no choice but to rescue their compatriots. The pair outran their pursuers and arrived on the surface in time to save Organa and Dantels from a TIE attack. The group then rescued Skywalker and Gillmunn from the Imperials. Gillmunn insisted on staying behind, but conceded that the Rebels could not save the planet and should flee. Sol was already captured and aboard Darth Vader's [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]], forcing them to leave without him. Antilles and Klivian drew the fleet's fire, allowing the others to escape aboard the ''Starduster'' before they jumped to hyperspace themselves.<ref name="In the Shadows of Their Fathers">''[[Star Wars: Empire: In the Shadows of Their Fathers]]''</ref>

Around two months after the abandonment of Yavin, with the Rebel leadership centered aboard roving fleets and in need of supplies, as well as compromised should Jorin Sol give away the escape algorithm used to plot hyperspace jumps when the fleet came under sudden attack, Antilles was part of a group that undertook a supply [[Battle of Kalist VI|raid]] on the planet [[Kalist VI/Legends|Kalist VI]]. Antilles led elements of Red Squadron in destroying the escort [[Frigate/Legends|frigate]] accompanying the Imperial fuel [[Tanker/Legends|tanker]] ''[[Nuna's Twins]]'', allowing the Rebels to hijack the tanker. Skywalker and Captain [[Harran]] led a [[prize crew]] that took over the ship and continued on to Kalist VI, where they planned to steal supplies from the Imperial [[Kalist Base|base]] and rescue Sol, held captive within. The half-dozen Red Squadron pilots continued on as well, harrying the ship as it emerged over Kalist VI until they allowed themselves to be driven off by the base's TIE complement, reinforcing the undercover Rebels' cover story. At a prearranged time, Antilles led his pilots and a Y-wing bomber group back to cover the mission's escape. Skywalker led the rescue not only of Sol, but of a mass of Jabiimi slaves they had not known to be at the base, and with cover from Antilles the entire group escaped.<ref name="The Wrong Side of the War">''[[Star Wars: Empire: The Wrong Side of the War]]''</ref>

[[File:WedgeCasual.jpg|thumb|left|180px|Antilles speaks with Skywalker.]]
In the next month, Antilles was part of a shipping [[Raid on an Imperial cargo convoy|raid]] over the planet [[Per Lupelo]]. The Rebels easily picked off the light enemy fighter cover until Skywalker's fighter lost power in the middle of the battle. With a TIE on Skywalker's tail, Antilles had to rush to defeat his own opponent before saving his friend. They successfully hijacked the four-ship convoy, bringing much-needed supplies to the fleet. After returning to the [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]] ''[[Rebel One]]'', Antilles fetched Skywalker so Rebel spymaster [[Tungo Li]] could inform him of a message sent by Skywalker's childhood friend [[Janek Sunber/Legends|Janek Sunber]], whom Skywalker had encountered as an [[Imperial officer/Legends|Imperial officer]] on Kalist VI. The message stated that Sunber wished to defect. Li considered it a trap, but Skywalker left to rescue him against orders. Meanwhile, Sol left his [[Bacta tank/Legends|bacta tank]] and attacked [[Deena Shan]], a supply [[Officer/Legends|officer]]. He did not kill her, instead revealing that he had been "reprogrammed" during his Imperial captivity but was fighting his conditioning. Antilles was chosen to interview him under Li's supervision, and Sol was told to rest and return to his duties later in the belief that he had overridden his Imperial brainwashing.<ref name="My Brother, My Enemy">''[[Star Wars: Rebellion: My Brother, My Enemy]]''</ref>

As soon as Sol was cleared to return to duty, however, he called in the Imperial fleet and attacked Organa and a portion of the ship's command staff. The fighter complement scrambled to defend the fleet, which could not flee together as Sol had given their escape algorithm to the Empire. The ships scattered, except ''Rebel One'', the [[Bridge (starship)/Legends|bridge]] of which was in chaos. Antilles remained, defending the headquarters ship and frantically [[Comlink/Legends|comming]] the bridge. Finally the injured Sol overcame his conditioning one last time and launched ''Rebel One'' into hyperspace, letting Antilles leave the [[Disaster at Deepspace Besh|battle]].<ref name="My Brother, My Enemy" /> Antilles was able to link up with the fleet element under Admiral Ackbar, and when the remaining crew of ''Rebel One'' returned to the fleet with information about an upcoming attack on the planet [[Ansion/Legends|Ansion]], Ackbar sent Antilles and Skywalker to warn the planet, though the Alliance did not have the strength to tackle the attack force head-on.<ref name="Small Victories">''[[Star Wars: Rebellion: Small Victories]]''</ref>

====Defectors and captors====
{{Quote|How was the hovertrain?''"<br />"''Food was good, but the service was lousy.|Kasan Moor and Wedge Antilles|<ref name="Rogue Squadron game" />}}
When elite Imperial storm [[Commando/Legends|commando]] General [[Crix Madine/Legends|Crix Madine]] was willing to defect to the Rebel Alliance, Rogue Squadron [[Battle of Corellia (1 ABY)|screened]] his pickup from a [[Unidentified Rebel safehouse (Coronet City)|safehouse]] in Coronet City, Corellia. Antilles detected odd readings near the meeting site and scouted the location of the anomaly with Skywalker, only to find Imperial [[Probe droid/Legends|probe droids]] spying. They destroyed the droids, but as they did so Imperial ground and air forces moved against the Rogues' superior officer, General [[Carlist Rieekan/Legends|Carlist Rieekan]], who was meeting with city officials in the [[Coronet Capitol Tower|Capitol Tower]]. Antilles rushed back to help secure the area, and kept protecting it while Skywalker sped to the [[Technology Center]], where Madine was besieged. Antilles held bombers off long enough that Han Solo and Chewbacca, nearby, were able to help evacuate the beleaguered Capitol Tower just before it was destroyed.<ref name="Rogue Squadron game" />

The Rogues soon found themselves cooperating with Madine. When the inhabitants of the planet [[Gerrard V]] revolted against the Empire, the Imperial [[Unidentified Imperial governor (Gerrard V)|governor]], began looting the world as he prepared to flee. The Rogues were [[Liberation of Gerrard V|dispatched]] to escort General Madine's Y-wings as they used their [[Ion cannon/Legends|ion cannons]] to disable the [[Yacht/Legends|yachts]] into which the plundered goods were being loaded. Antilles led half of the unit to one [[Unidentified city (Gerrard V)|city]], where they were attacked by the [[128th TIE Interceptor Squadron]], an elite unit under Lieutenant [[Kasan Moor/Legends|Kasan Moor]]. He had to call in Skywalker's forces to reinforce him, allowing the Rogues to defeat the 128th and capture Moor. Moor, an Alderaanian, expressed a desire to defect, and she was admitted to the squadron after some consideration.<ref name="Rogue Squadron game" />

[[File:JadeMoonBattle-RogueSquadron.jpg|thumb|right|200px|Rogue Squadron raids the Jade Moon.]]
Though Antilles remained distrustful of her, Moor began giving the locations of Imperial bases to the Rebellion, leading to strikes by Rogue Squadron. An Imperial supply depot on the planet [[Loronar/Legends|Loronar's]] [[Jade Moon]] [[Battle of the Jade Moon|fell]] to Crix Madine's commandos while the Rogues provided air cover and disabled the [[Jade Moon supply base|depot's]] shield. In a swift [[Raid on Balmorra|raid]], Antilles and several more Rogues then struck a factory on the planet [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]] that produced [[Walker/Legends|walker]] and TIEs. They subsequently took Y-wings to [[Assault on Kile II|bomb]] the [[Imperial Enclave]] on the planet [[Kile II]]. As that mission was completed, Antilles was ambushed by TIE Interceptors. Unable to avoid them in the sluggish Y-wing and subjected to heavy fire, he put down rather than be shot out of the [[Atmosphere/Legends|sky]], and was captured by Imperial forces before the Rogues could intervene.<ref name="Rogue Squadron game" />

His captors transferred Antilles to the [[Spice mines of Kessel/Legends|penal facilities]] of the planet [[Kessel/Legends|Kessel]]. Aboard a Kesselian [[Hovertrain/Legends|hovertrain]] taking him from his initial [[Unidentified Kessel holding facility|holding facility]] to [[Prison/Legends|prison]], Antilles was suddenly [[Rescue on Kessel|rescued]] by his fellow Rogues as they disabled the [[Train/Legends|train]]. Brought his own X-wing, Antilles was relieved to escape and shared what he had learned aboard the hovertrain: other Rebels were being held in Kessel's prisons. Madine and his commandos were called in to perform a rescue. Antilles helped provide cover as Madine's men raided several penitentiaries based on Antilles's information. After this series of raids and her participation in his rescue, Moor had earned Antilles's trust.<ref name="Rogue Squadron game" />

Rogue Squadron then turned its attention to the emerging threat of ambitious and oppressive [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Kohl Seerdon]], formerly Moor's patron. Seerdon was planning to move against [[Thyferra/Legends|Thyferra]], the vital world that produced [[Bacta/Legends|bacta]], and shut off Rebel access to the immeasurably important healing agent. The Rogues began striking at Seerdon's holdings, hoping to disrupt his battle preparations and eliminate his supply chain. They began with a hit-and-run A-wing [[Battle above Taloraan|strike]] at planet [[Taloraan/Legends|Taloraan]], where the Empire mined the [[Tibanna/Legends|tibanna]] gas that powered its weapons. With support from a [[CR90 corvette/Legends|CR90 corvette]], they destroyed much of Seerdon's accumulated gas stockpile. At the same time, a commando unit attempted to steal several [[All Terrain Personal Transport/Legends|All Terrain Personal Transports]] from a [[Weapons Research Facility|research facility]] on the planet [[Fest/Legends|Fest]]. Their escape was compromised, and the Rogues sped to Fest to [[Escape from Fest|cover]] the AT-PTs as they made their way to an Alliance transport under heavy Imperial attack. After shepherding the walkers to safety, they destroyed the research facility.<ref name="Rogue Squadron game" />

Seerdon then turned to [[Blockade on Chandrila|blockading]] Chandrila, the peaceful, anti-Imperial homeworld of Rebel Alliance leader Mon Mothma, in retaliation for his recent losses. He isolated one of its [[Nayli|major cities]] and began bombarding it, prompting Rieekan to send the Rogues to escort a relief hovertrain filled with supplies to the besieged city and eliminate Seerdon's forces. Antilles helped guard the hovertrain as Imperial fighters and bombers assaulted it, and once it reached the city safely he began shooting down Seerdon's bombers. Once that threat was eliminated, Rieekan sent several shuttles to evacuate the population, which the Rogues protected. They then settled in to defend Chandrila until Seerdon's threat was eliminated, letting Seerdon escape the planet. In retaliation for the attack on Chandrila, the Rogues [[Raid on Sullust|struck]] at one of Seerdon's bases on the planet [[Sullust/Legends|Sullust]]. Flying into a [[Volcano/Legends|volcano]], they destroyed the important shielded [[Capacitor (Sullust)|station]] within, exacting their revenge for Chandrila. However, as they finished the mission, they learned that Seerdon had decoyed them into the attack and then used it as a diversion, striking at Thyferra while Rogue Squadron was otherwise occupied. The Rogues rushed to Thyferra, and in a hard-fought [[Attack on Thyferra|battle]] they protected Rebel bacta supplies and destroyed Seerdon's invasion force. Skywalker personally killed Seerdon when he shot down the Moff's [[Sentinel-class landing craft/Legends|''Sentinel''-class landing craft]], ending the crisis.<ref name="Rogue Squadron game" />

[[File:Wedge_Antilles_SoC.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Antilles in 1 ABY]]
In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]], Antilles was stationed at the [[Hidden Rebel Base|Rebel outpost]] near the city of [[Kor Vella/Legends|Kor Vella]] on his homeworld of Corellia. While assigned to that hidden base, Antilles got into a dogfight with several TIE Interceptors, and his fighter was damaged. While it was being repaired, he worked to recruit new allies for the Rebels.<ref name="Galaxies">{{GalaxiesAED}}</ref> He entered into negotiations with a group of [[Corellian Engineering Corporation/Legends|Corellian Engineering Corporation]] workers' union leaders, who were interested in joining the Alliance, but wanted to hear Antilles&mdash;by now considered a hero of the Rebel movement&mdash;speak about the Battle of Yavin.<ref name="The Making of Baron Fel" /> He had a Rebel agent referred to him by Alliance [[Major/Legends|Major]] [[Qual'do Herm]] carry a letter confirming their meeting to the prospective allies' spokesman [[Devlin (officer)|Devlin]]. Devlin agreed to the time and place, and Antilles gave a speech that convinced them to throw their support behind the Rebel Alliance. Only one union leader, [[Iris]], dissented. Antilles had to send the same Rebel agent to reason with her, as he knew she was likely to turn the other union leaders in to the Empire. When she insisted on selling them out and drew a [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] on the agent, the agent killed her, an outcome Antilles regretted but accepted as the only way to protect the Alliance.<ref name="Galaxies" />

On hearing intelligence reports of Imperials bringing [[Power generator/Legends|power generators]] from the abandoned [[Dantooine base/Legends|Rebel base]] on Dantooine to Corellia, Antilles called on the same agent to capture the officer in charge of the mysterious project, General [[Graise]], and bring him to Kor Vella for interrogation. The agent did so, and Graise confessed that the generators were being rebuilt and shipped off-planet for use in another project. Antilles sent the agent to [[Assassin/Legends|assassinate]] the man in charge of that endeavor, General [[Boize]], allowing the Rebels to recover the valuable generators and stymie the Imperial plot. Further information from documents on Graise's person revealed that he had been running [[Unidentified storehouse|storehouse]] of impounded starships and parts. Antilles again ordered the agent to undertake a mission, this time to seize the [[Code cylinder/Legends|code cylinder]] allowing access to the building from [[Emil]], the [[Quartermaster/Legends|quartermaster]] for the storehouse. Once Antilles gained the code cylinder, the Rebels were able to raid the facility for an important boost to their starfleet. With no more tasks for the agent, Antilles forwarded the being to Leia Organa for further assignments.<ref name="Galaxies" />

[[File:Wedge_Antilles_-_GH.jpg|thumb|right|200px|Antilles ready to fight]]
Antilles later used another agent to eavesdrop on two Imperial officers in the city of [[Bela Vistal/Legends|Bela Vistal]] on Corellia in the hopes of finding the location of a hidden [[Imperial Base (Corellia)|Imperial base]] in which several confiscated Rebel X-wings were stored. The agent [[Mission to Bela Vistal|found and infiltrated]] the base, killed the guards, and disabled the security systems, allowing the Rebellion to retake the fighters.<ref name="SWG:SS">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=faction|Rebel|Stolen Starships|Corellia}}</ref> During the Rebel holiday [[Remembrance Day]], 1 ABY, Antilles attended a celebration in Coronet. There, he tasked a Rebel to [[Rescue at Yavin 4|rescue]] several Alliance pilots who had been captured and imprisoned in a [[Detainment Facility]] near an Imperial [[Imperial Fortress (Yavin 4)|base]] erected on Yavin 4. The agent completed the mission and returned to confirm the success with Antilles&mdash;and to ask the famous pilot for an [[autograph]]. The agent was awarded the [[Rebel Alliance Badge of Valor]] by Wedge Antilles for the accomplishment.<ref name="SWG:ED">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=event|Empire Day}}</ref> While traveling with several other Rogues to inspect a Corellian Engineering Corporation yard after the [[Battle of Talus]], Antilles was ambushed by [[4-LOM/Legends|4-LOM]] and another [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]]. After a firefight that wounded most of his companions, he was captured and turned over to the Empire, having been put on the [[Emperor's Most Wanted]] list.<ref name="Galactic Hunters Dark Side">{{SWGTCG|set=Galactic Hunters|scenario=Dark Side scenario campaign}}</ref> A Rebel strike force [[Mission to Bestine|freed]] him and several other inmates from imprisonment near [[Bestine (city)/Legends|Bestine]] on Tatooine, returning them to the Rebel cause.<ref name="Galactic Hunters Light Side">{{SWGTCG|set=Galactic Hunters|scenario=Light Side scenario campaign}}</ref>

When [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]], [[Baron Administrator/Legends|Baron Administrator]] of [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]] and sympathetic to the Rebels, contacted the Alliance with information that a missing medical shipment of [[Ryll/Legends|ryll]] they had been seeking was located on the [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroid]] [[Skip 52]] of the notorious [[Asteroid field/Legends|asteroid field]] hideout, [[Smuggler's Run/Legends|Smuggler's Run]], Antilles was [[Mission to Skip 52|sent]] to meet a Rebel ally who had been working for Calrissian at the planet [[Wrea/Legends|Wrea]]. He flew the agent through the treacherous asteroid field to Skip 52 in a modified two-seat Headhunter. When they arrived they found that [[Imperial Intelligence/Legends|Imperial Intelligence]] agents under the notorious and secretive [[Cronal|Blackhole]] had already taken control of the [[Spice/Legends|spice]]. Antilles and his ally battled Blackhole's [[Shadow stormtrooper/Legends|shadow stormtroopers]], overcoming them after a drawn-out gunfight. The pair contacted Calrissian, who arranged to ship the ryll to the medical facility for which it had originally been destined.<ref name="Agents of Deception">{{SWGTCG|set=Agents of Deception|scenario=Light Side scenario campaign}}</ref>

[[File:Wedge_Antilles-One_Year_Earlier.jpg|200px|thumb|left|Antilles on Hoth, 2 ABY]]
Antilles was at the planet [[Xyquine II]] when it was struck by an Imperial [[Battle of Xyquine II|attack]].<ref name="The Last Command">''[[The Last Command]]''</ref> There, to cover the retreat, Rebel pilot [[Pash Cracken/Legends|Pash Cracken]] invented the [[Cracken Twist]], a trick in which modified jump coordinates were transmitted to recipients who knew to subtract from the second digit in the coordinates for the actual course, allowing them to fool eavesdropping enemy ships. The Cracken Twist proved popular, prompting Antilles to design a maneuver that could be used when a Cracken Twist was called for, letting any eavesdroppers think the motion was the twist. Antilles's invention, the [[screen formation]], worked both as a distraction and as a way for a handful of skilled pilots to provide comprehensive protection, forming a sphere of starfighters, rapidly switching position, around an escorted ship.<ref name="The Last Command Sourcebook">''[[The Last Command Sourcebook]]''</ref>

Around [[2 ABY/Legends|2 ABY]],<ref name="ToppsDate">{{Topps|set=2015 Topps Star Wars Illustrated: The Empire Strikes Back|cardname=One Year Earlier: Wedge Antilles|archivedate=20240529181450}} dates its events to one [[Standard year/Legends|year]] before those of [[Star Wars: Episode V The Empire Strikes Back|''Star Wars'': Episode V ''The Empire Strikes Back'']], which ''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates to [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]].</ref> Antilles participated in routine training operations with his fellow Rogues, including Janson,<ref name="ToppsWedge">{{Topps|set=2015 Topps Star Wars Illustrated: The Empire Strikes Back|cardname=One Year Earlier: Wedge Antilles|archivedate=20240529181450}}</ref> Ralter, and Skywalker. Following an exercise in deep space, the Rebel pilots put down on the [[South Ridge/Legends|South Ridge]] of the Outer Rim planet Hoth to perform maintenance on their starfighters before returning to the Alliance's fleet.<ref name="ToppsLuke">{{Topps|set=2015 Topps Star Wars Illustrated: The Empire Strikes Back|cardname=One Year Earlier: Luke Skywalker|archivedate=20240529182322}}</ref>

====Freedom's winter====
{{Quote|If the Death Star didn't stop you an' me&hellip;what can these things do?|Wedge Antilles, to Luke Skywalker|<ref name="Star Wars (1977) 40">[[Star Wars (1977) 40|''Star Wars'' (1977) 40]]</ref>}}
By [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]],<ref name="VDate">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of {{Film|V}} to [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]].</ref> the Alliance's [[Echo Base/Legends|Echo Base]] had been established on Hoth. Antilles and the other Rogues were assigned there.<ref name="The Empire Strikes Back" /> As an expert pilot and experienced officer, Antilles was put in charge of training new pilots at the base.<ref name="Special Edition Limited Commander Wedge Antilles">{{CCG|set=Special Edition Limited|cardname=Commander Wedge Antilles}}</ref> While escorting a vital supply convoy, Renegade Flight was [[Battle of Derra IV|ambushed]] near the planet [[Derra IV/Legends|Derra IV]]; the convoy was lost with no survivors. In the wake of the battle, Rieekan promoted Skywalker to fill Narra's position.<ref name="The Empire Strikes Back radio drama" /> When Skywalker went missing during a ground patrol of Hoth not long afterward, the Rogues were sent out to rescue him and Solo, who had gone out in search of him upon [[Tauntaun/Legends|tauntaun]], as soon as the base's T-47 airspeeders were properly adapted to Hoth's cold. Senesca found them after they had managed to survive the bitterly cold night.<ref name="The Empire Strikes Back" />

[[File:WedgeMissionAccomplished.jpg|thumb|200px|Antilles flies through the legs of an AT-AT walker.]]
Later in the day, an Imperial [[Viper probe droid/Legends|probe droid]] was discovered spying on the base. The Rebels immediately prepared to evacuate their new base. When Vader's Death Squadron arrived in the [[Hoth system/Legends|Hoth system]], Rogue Group was assigned to hold off the Imperial landing force and [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|defend]] the planetary shield that protected the base from orbital bombardment and direct landings. With Wes Janson as his gunner, Antilles piloted his now-modified T-47, dubbed a "[[Snowspeeder/Legends|snowspeeder]]," against the Empire's powerful [[All Terrain Armored Transport/Legends|All Terrain Armored Transports]] as [[Rogue Three/Legends|Rogue Three]].<ref name="The Empire Strikes Back" /> They first protected [[Outpost Beta/Legends|Outpost Beta]], site of the ion cannon covering the evacuation, then moved on to defend the shield generator against the main force.<ref name="Rogue Leader game" /> When the AT-ATs' armor proved too strong for the speeders' blasters, Skywalker ordered a shift to using the T-47s' industrial [[Power harpoon launcher|tow cables]] to trip up the walkers. Skywalker made the first pass, but his gunner, Dak Ralter, was killed in the attempt. Skywalker, as Rogue Leader, ordered Antilles and Janson to make the first trip. Janson made the harpoon shot, and Antilles looped his speeder around the AT-AT<ref name="The Empire Strikes Back" /> [[Blizzard 2/Legends|Blizzard 2]]<ref name="Inside the Worlds">''[[Inside the Worlds of Star Wars Trilogy]]''</ref> until the machine's legs were entangled and it tumbled to Hoth's icy surface. With the machine's vulnerable neck better exposed, Antilles scored a shot that destroyed the downed walker.<ref name="The Empire Strikes Back" /> When Skywalker was shot down, Rieekan contacted Antilles for an update on the situation, denying his request to pick up the flight leader. Instead, the general listened as Antilles reported Skywalker's destruction of an AT-AT walker on the ground and turned command of the Rogues over to the pilot.<ref name="The Empire Strikes Back radio drama" /> Antilles directed Skywalker to a nearby tauntaun, on which he rode out of the line of fire and back to base.<ref name="Rebel Strike" />

The Rebels were unable to hold off the Imperial ground assault, and Leia Organa called the retreat after Imperials entered the base. Imperial General [[Maximilian Veers/Legends|Maximilian Veers]] destroyed the shield generator in the next minute.<ref name="The Empire Strikes Back" /> With their airspeeder damaged and Antilles's right arm injured, he and Janson had to bail from the crippled craft and march to the rear of the base, where they transferred to starfighters and prepared to escort the remaining evacuation transports as they ran the gauntlet of the Imperial fleet,<ref name="Gauntlet">{{WEGCite|story=Running the Gauntlet|book=Galaxy Guide 3: The Empire Strikes Back|reprint=1}}</ref> but delayed their evacuation until they were joined by Skywalker.<ref name="The Empire Strikes Back radio drama" />

While on the ground, Antilles took command of an infantry unit struggling to defend against the Imperial advance. There, he learned that General Crix Madine had been captured by Imperial forces in the course of the evacuation and, grabbing another soldier, rushed to rescue Madine in a T-47. Antilles found Imperial officer [[Jeffren Brek]] and several [[Cold assault stormtrooper|snowtroopers]] marching Madine and two of the general's aides to a shuttle and attacked the Imperials. Brek escaped in the shuttle with Madine, but Antilles managed to save the two subordinates, who informed him that Brek was taking Madine to the Star Destroyer [[Rebel Dream|''Tyrant'']] for transfer to prison. Antilles dispatched the soldier whom he had brought with him to arrange a raid on the ''Tyrant'', which successfully recovered Madine.<ref name="The Price of Victory Light Side">{{SWGTCG|set=The Price of Victory|scenario=Light Side scenario campaign}}</ref>

As Skywalker arrived outside the evacuated Echo Base, now overrun by Imperial forces, Antilles informed his comrade of the planned Alliance [[Haven (rendezvous point)|rendezvous]] above the galactic plane, the coordinates of which had been provided to R2-D2. Their position wracked by an explosion, the remains of Rogue Flight left in the final evacuation group and, without the covering fire previously provided by the base's ion cannon,<ref name="The Empire Strikes Back radio drama" /> were assigned to escort the three remaining transports,<ref name="RebelStrikePG">''[[Star Wars: Rogue Squadron III: Rebel Strike: The Official Nintendo Player's Guide]]''</ref> the [[Thon's Orchard/Legends|''Thon's Orchard'']],<ref name="Gauntlet" /> [[Dutyfree/Legends|''Dutyfree'']],<ref name="Isard's Revenge">''[[X-Wing: Isard's Revenge]]''</ref> and [[Bright Hope/Legends|''Bright Hope'']].<ref name="CCL">{{CCG|set=Cloud City Limited|cardname=''Bright Hope''}}</ref> Taking off in his X-wing, Antilles defended the transports from fighter and bomber attack as they loaded their passengers aboard<ref name="Rogue Leader game" /> and launched into Hoth's atmosphere.<ref name="Rebel Strike" />

''Dutyfree'' [[Navigator/Legends|navigator]] [[Areta Bell]] plotted an unpredictable course capable of penetrating Imperial lines,<ref name="Isard's Revenge" /> and the Rebel craft approached their escape vector only to be obstructed by a Star Destroyer. Antilles hastily pulled off an expert [[Tallon split]] maneuver with a Y-wing crewed by Klivian and Janson, confusing the Star Destroyer's tracking arrays long enough for him to destroy one of the ship's sensors, giving the convoy an avenue of escape. Antilles would later include the gauntlet-running in his personal memoirs, which were excerpted by Voren Na'al in a report on the events.<ref name="Gauntlet" /> Skywalker ordered the transport and Antilles ahead while he hung behind, jumping to [[Dagobah/Legends|Dagobah]] to continue his [[Jedi training/Legends|Jedi training]] instead of escaping to the fleet.<ref name="The Empire Strikes Back radio drama" />

Though Antilles initiated a hyperspace jump to safety,<ref name="Gauntlet" /> he returned to and was stranded on Hoth, where he encountered [[Arns Grimraker]], a notorious pirate, arms dealer, and [[Scavenger/Legends|scavenger]], who was attempting to salvage equipment left behind by the Alliance, and preparing to attack the Rebel holdout. Antilles killed him, and escaped aboard the pirate's [[heavy freighter]] the ''[[Death Merchant]]''. The story of the events became a favorite of Antilles's, and he took to embellishing it wildly, generally stating that he had himself been stranded on Hoth with Janson for months, only to finally escape in Grimraker's ship and be rescued by Skywalker. Frequently, Antilles claimed Janson had died, usually as a prank on rookies who would then be shocked to meet Janson alive and well.<ref name="Under the Ice">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/article/sw20031218hoth3|series=Hoth: Under the Ice|text=Part 3: Merchants of Death}}</ref>

===Rogue Leader===
====Running the Rogues====
{{Quote|Wedge is in command of Rogue Squadron now, and he told me if I ever needed them they'd come running.|Luke Skywalker, to Chewbacca|<ref name="Shadows of the Empire" />}}
[[File:WedgeBigGun.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Antilles on the rescue mission]]
Antilles boarded the cruiser [[Champion (vehicle)|''Champion'']], which was to proceed to the rendezvous point. It came under attack from the ''Tyrant'', however, and fighters had to scramble to defend the ship until it could jump to hyperspace. The same soldier Antilles had earlier sent to free Madine flew in the battle despite having little fighter experience and impressed Antilles, who later congratulated him with Madine in the officers' lounge. Intercepted signals revealed that the ''Tyrant'' had been ordered to support an Imperial ambush at the gas giant [[Bespin/Legends|Bespin]], and Antilles sent the same soldier to make contact with Rebel informer [[Yoxgit/Legends|Yoxgit]] on Cloud City and determine what was happening. He learned that the Empire had captured Han Solo and frozen him in [[Carbonite/Legends|carbonite]].<ref name="The Price of Victory Light Side" /> A bounty hunter named [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]] had taken possession of Solo to deliver him to the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] crime lord [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure]], to whom Solo owed a debt.<ref name="The Empire Strikes Back" /> Antilles rushed to Bespin and led a [[Occupation of Bespin|raid]] on Fett as he transported Solo, but the bounty hunter escaped with Antilles's friend.<ref name="The Price of Victory Dark Side">{{SWGTCG|set=The Price of Victory|scenario=Dark Side scenario campaign}}</ref> Antilles was alarmed and frustrated, but began preparing for another rescue effort.<ref name="The Price of Victory Light Side" />

He was put to work rebuilding the survivors of Hoth and new pilots into a working unit, officially stationed aboard Ackbar's flagship [[Home One/Legends|''Home One'']] and able to quickly lift for any hotspot.<ref name="Galaxy Guide 3 Second Edition" /> [[Will Scotian/Legends|Will Scotian]] was among the pilots he recruited after seeing Scotian's excellent record at the Alliance's [[Oracle Base]].<ref name="Shadows of the Empire Sourcebook" /> Though offered the chance to upgrade to the newer A-wing or [[A/SF-01 B-wing starfighter/Legends|B-wing starfighters]], Antilles insisted that the workhorse X-wing was good enough to remain the Rogues' primary starfighter, preferring that more advanced fighters be given to less talented pilots who needed the edge.<ref name="Galaxy Guide 5">''[[Galaxy Guide 5: Return of the Jedi]]''</ref> Under Antilles's leadership, the refurbished squadron's position as the most elite starfighter unit in the Rebellion was confirmed.<ref name="Galaxy Guide 5 Second Edition">[[Galaxy Guide 5: Return of the Jedi (Second Edition)|''Galaxy Guide 5: Return of the Jedi'', Second Edition]]</ref> Also, as a commander, Antilles's expertise was put to use for the wider Alliance. He recorded the training [[Hologram/Legends|hologram]] "[[Alliance Strategy and Tactics Lecture 137/Legends|Alliance Strategy and Tactics Lecture 137: Combat Starfighters]]" for distribution throughout the Rebellion, in which he outlined the workings and objectives of Alliance [[New Republic Starfighter Command/Legends|Starfighter Command]] and presented tactics and strategy for starfighter combat.<ref name="Rebel Alliance Sourcebook">[[The Rebel Alliance Sourcebook (Second Edition)|''The Rebel Alliance Sourcebook'', Second Edition]]</ref>

[[File:Starwarsrogueleader06.jpg|thumb|right|200px|Antilles flies through the Maw base.]]
Antilles was sent to [[Battle near the Maw|scout]] [[Maw Cluster/Legends|the Maw]], a [[Black hole/Legends|black hole]] cluster suspected of hiding an Imperial [[Maw Imperial Prison|prison]]. Flying a Y-wing for the mission, Antilles entered the Maw's asteroid field with Rogues Three and [[Rogue Four/Legends|Four]]. There they came under attack from TIEs and, after fighting their way through Imperial forces, disabled a force field to gain access to the prison facility. They received a transmission from [[Karie Neth/Legends|Karie Neth]], the leader of the Rebel prisoners, who was engaged in a prison break. Coming to her aid, Antilles destroyed the prison's defenses, allowing Neth and her contingent of prisoners to escape.<ref name="Rogue Leader game" /> Neth would later join the squadron, replacing a [[Unidentified Bothan pilot|Bothan]] lost during a covert mission.<ref name="Death Star II Karie Neth">{{CCG|set=Death Star II Limited|cardname=Karie Neth}}</ref> Antilles also rescued [[Keir Santage/Legends|Keir Santage]], who similarly became a Rogue.<ref name="Death Star II Keir Santage">{{CCG|set=Death Star II Limited|cardname=Keir Santage}}</ref>

When Imperial Admiral [[Wooyou Senn]]'s [[Task Force Vengeance/Legends|Task Force ''Vengeance'']] attacked the Rebel hospital station ''[[Hormuuz]]'' in the [[Gelgelar system/Legends|Gelgelar system]], the Rogues [[Evacuation of Gelgelar|defended]] the evacuation, working with [[Gold Squadron (Rebel Alliance)/Legends|Gold Squadron]]. After their flight, while the injured were being transferred to the [[Hospital ship/Legends|medical frigate]] ''Redemption'', the Rebels came under attack from the Star Destroyer ''[[Nemesis]]''. The Rogues and Golds, forced to fly Headhunters, [[Skirmish near Gelgelar|covered]] the fleet's escape. When a supply convoy headed for the [[Airam sector/Legends|Airam sector]] was [[Battle of Halbara/Legends|ambushed]] in the [[Halbara system/Legends|Halbara system]], the Rogues fought off the attack. The Rogues and [[Green Squadron (Rebel Alliance)/Legends|Green Squadron]] then made a raid of their own, [[Attack on the Gelgelar system|retaking]] supplies from the captured ''Hormuuz'' with capital ship aid.<ref name="Balance of Power">''[[Star Wars: X-Wing vs. TIE Fighter]]''</ref>

In order to gauge the strength of Task Force ''Vengeance'', the Rogues were [[Mission to Almaran|dispatched]] to a [[Almaran system|fleet rendezvous point]] in speedy A-wings. There they scanned the task force's ships as they arrived and destroyed cargo ships bearing munitions as they found them. On identifying Senn's flagship, the [[Star Dreadnought/Legends|Star Dreadnought]] [[Vengeance (Executor-class)/Legends|''Vengeance'']], Antilles departed to report to his commanders. The [[MC80 Liberty Type Heavy Star Cruiser/Legends|MC80 Star Cruiser]] [[Liberty/Legends|''Liberty'']] drew elements of Task Force ''Vengeance'' to the [[Goff system/Legends|Goff system]], where the Rogues served as part of a [[Ambush in the Goff system|trap]] that destroyed two Star Destroyers. The Rogues then participated in the capture of the [[Immobilizer 418 Interdictor-class Heavy Cruiser|Immobilizer 418 cruiser]] ''[[Compellor/Legends|Compellor]]'' in the [[Battle of Swellen]], holding off an Imperial counterattack. They then [[First attack on the Peregrine|guarded]] the ''Compellor''{{'s}} arrival at [[Mobetta system/Legends|Mobetta]] and, after the first attack was defeated, [[Second attack on the Peregrine|held off]] a second Imperial assault fleet. Continuing to work with Green Squadron's B-wings, the Rogues participated in an [[Ambush in the Derilyn system|ambush]] of an Imperial fleet sent to reinforce Task Force ''Vengeance''. Afterward, they received a distress call from the [[Deep Space Manufacturing Facility|X7 factory]] ''[[Gallofree]]'' at Mobetta and returned there to defend it against an Imperial [[Retreat from Gallofree|attack]]. Though they could not save ''Compellor'', they covered the evacuation of the [[Airam (group)|Airam]] Rebels from the factory at great risk before withdrawing.<ref name="Balance of Power" />

Airam leader [[Tamaron]] agreed to supply the Alliance with [[Warhead/Legends|warheads]] in gratitude. Antilles's Rogues guarded the transfer against Imperial interference. When the Imperials did attack, the Rogues quickly [[Mission to Kuras Drift|beat off]] the interlopers. When the Airam clan leader [[Ilay]] attempted to negotiate a treaty with Senn, the Rogues were part of the forces that [[Battle of Aiqin 4|disrupted]] the meeting, capturing Ilay before retreating. With intelligence on a rendezvous Ilay had set up to supply the Imperials, the Rogues, equipped with B-wings, [[Battle of Dega|struck]] the convoy at [[Dega]], destroying all the supply freighters in a prolonged raid. Senn, with his forces reduced and strained for supplies, pressed forward with an [[Battle of Nocto|attack]] on the Rebel [[Shipyard/Legends|shipyards]] in the [[Nocto system/Legends|Nocto system]]. The Rebels were able to destroy the [[Rage (Imperial-class)/Legends|''Rage'']] and the ''Vengeance'' in the battle, killing Senn and putting an end to Task Force ''Vengeance''{{'s}} menace of the Airam sector.<ref name="Balance of Power" />

[[File:Battle_Over_Geonosis.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Antilles battles over Geonosis.]]
On hearing a tip that several Rebel scientists captured on Hoth were being held in a [[Bakura Imperial Prison|detention facility]] over the planet [[Bakura/Legends|Bakura]], the Rogues were sent to [[Raid at Bakura|free]] them. Taking a B-wing, Antilles arrived to find a transport departing the station. He rushed to disable it with the B-wing's ion cannons, allowing a Rebel evacuation transport to dock and transfer the prisoners over for rescue. As a succession of transport ships departed, Antilles disabled each one. When Klivian's fighter was crippled in the dogfight, plummeting to Bakura's surface, Antilles quickly docked with the station and stole a TIE bomber to provide a two-seat craft. Flying to the surface and through a heavily defended [[Water/Legends|ice]] crevasse, he picked up Klivian and returned to the Rebel forces in orbit. However, when he returned, an [[Imperial escort carrier (storm commando)|storm commando escort carrier]] recaptured the scientists and fled to the planet [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]]. Under Madine's direction, Antilles, back in his X-wing, led two Rogues and the transports to Geonosis in pursuit. When Imperial capital ships arrived, it was plain that they had flown into a trap. Antilles covered for the transports as they escaped, destroying a storm commando escort carrier and losing his own [[Stabilizer/Legends|stabilizer]] in the explosion. Antilles plummeted to the surface, where he abandoned his X-wing and evaded stormtroopers who had themselves landed in [[Escape pod/Legends|escape pods]] from the destroyed ship. Antilles also encountered [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-Series battle droids]], manufactured on Geonosis for the Clone Wars. He then came under attack from Sarkli, the former Rogue who had turned traitor and now served with the storm commandos, after Sarkli commandeered a LAAT/i [[Gunship/Legends|gunship]] left on the planet. Taking over a turret on the ground, Antilles shot down the gunship, then found an abandoned [[Delta-7 Aethersprite-class light interceptor/Legends|Delta-7 Aethersprite]] starfighter, another Clone Wars relic. After his [[R5-G8/Legends|R5 unit]] repaired the fighter, he returned to orbit, where Madine had just arrived in a Nebulon-B, and flew the Aethersprite against the remaining Imperial forces.<ref name="Rebel Strike" />

When reports that a platform over the planet [[Destrillion]] was being used for Imperial research arrived, Antilles was sent to [[Mission to Destrillion|scout]] the facility in an A-wing and note vulnerable points for attack by his squadron in Y-wings. Piloting through a series of energy-shielded tunnels in open space, he made his way to an open area, where he found a swarm of [[TIE/hu "Hunter" Multi-Role Starfighter|TIE Hunters]]. Trapped inside by force fields, he had to take on the TIE Hunters alone. After eliminating them, a further tunnel opened, allowing him to continue toward the base. Exiting, he found only an Imperial convoy. He returned to the fleet, which came under fire from the surface of Destrillion's sister planet, [[Dubrillion/Legends|Dubrillion]]. The Rebels had been lured into a trap so that a superlaser based on Dubrillion could be used against them. Antilles led a Y-wing [[Battle of Dubrillion (Galactic Civil War)|bombing run]] to Dubrillion, targeting the focusing dishes for the superlaser. Unable to reach the full facility with a bomber, Antilles put down and commandeered an AT-ST, penetrating the superlaser construct. Within an internal rail system, he then transferred to an idle AT-AT and destroyed the reactor turbines. With the superlaser destroyed, he escaped in his Y-wing.<ref name="Rebel Strike" />

Skywalker eventually joined Antilles at the rendezvous, missing a hand after a [[Duel on Cloud City/Legends|confrontation]] with Darth Vader in Bespin's Cloud City. There, Skywalker had escaped with Organa and Chewbacca, freed from Imperial custody by Han Solo's old friend, Lando Calrissian, but had also been unsuccessful in attempting to free Solo.<ref name="The Empire Strikes Back" /> Skywalker, Organa, Calrissian, and Chewbacca decided to devote their efforts to tracking down Fett in an attempt to rescue Solo, pulling Rogue Leader Skywalker away from his duties. Antilles swiftly struck up a friendship with Calrissian, new to the Rebellion.<ref name="Shadows of the Empire" /> During Skywalker's recovery, an Imperial [[Strike-class medium cruiser|''Strike''-class medium cruiser]] [[Skirmish at Haven|came across]] the convoy, and a [[Unidentified Rebel commander (Haven)|Rebel commander]] scrambled the Rogues to prevent the intruder from revealing the fleet's location. Antilles sent "[[Rogue Five/Legends|Rogue Five]]" off in a wide arc while he swept the other Rogues toward the Strike Cruiser as it disgorged TIEs. Under Antilles, the squadron cut through the TIEs, while the running Strike Cruiser, its shields focused to the rear, succumbed to fire from "Rogue Five," who had looped in front of it unnoticed.<ref name="Shadows of the Empire comic 1">[[Shadows of the Empire 1|''Shadows of the Empire'' 1]]</ref>

[[File:WedgeRedOne.jpg|thumb|right|200px|Wedge Antilles flying his fighter, which displays his many kill silhouettes.]]
With Skywalker committed to another task, and Antilles already having frequently assumed command duties, the decision was made at the rendezvous point to put Antilles fully in command of Rogue Squadron.<ref name="The New Essential Guide to Characters" /> He was promoted from the [[Military rank/Legends|rank]] of captain to commander, though rank meant little to Antilles, and he never bothered to correct frequent references to him as a captain.<ref name="Galaxy Guide 3 Second Edition" /><ref name="The Truce at Bakura Sourcebook">''[[The Truce at Bakura Sourcebook]]''</ref> He made a point to acknowledge that if Skywalker ever needed the Rogues, he would not hesitate to assist, and when Skywalker accompanied the Rogues on missions, Antilles deferred to Commander Skywalker, granting him command and the Rogue Leader designation while Antilles flew as Rogue One.<ref name="Shadows of the Empire Sourcebook" /><ref name="Shadows of the Empire" />

Shortly after Skywalker's return from Cloud City, he led Antilles with [[Raptor Squad]], composed of the two pilots, Calrissian, and Chewbacca, on a [[mission to steal hyperdrive components]] from an Imperial [[drone freighter]] convoy. Antilles brought the squad's [[Nu-class attack shuttle/Legends|''Nu''-class attack shuttle]] out of hyperspace in close proximity to the [[Drone vessel 171|target vessel]], allowing them to evade the sensors of the convoy's [[Unidentified escort frigate|escort frigate]] and board the [[Drone barge/Legends|drone]] undetected. The docking hatch blown, Antilles hijacked the ship's helm and weapons systems while Skywalker left to engage Imperial forces hidden on board. As the escort frigate moved to intercept, Chewbacca activated the drone's manual override, allowing Antilles to jump away to [[Lightspeed/Legends|lightspeed]].<ref name="Drone Alone" />

For a [[Fondor shipyard assault|strike]] at the vital [[Fondor Shipyards/Legends|Imperial shipyards]] of the planet [[Fondor/Legends|Fondor]] and a [[Cloaking device/Legends|cloaking device]]-equipped [[Unidentified Executor-class Star Dreadnought|''Executor''-class Star Dreadnought]] under construction there, Antilles and two other Rogues flew captured TIE Hunters and presented themselves as escorting a captured Rebel transport; the transport was in fact a droid ship programmed to ram the shipyards' control center. They were detected by spaceport control, however, and had to battle to defend the transport as it made its suicide run. Once the control center was destroyed, the Rebel fleet arrived. Antilles brought down the shields and then led the Rogues in a run to eliminate the Star Dreadnought. He destroyed its cloaking generators, and the fleet eliminated the ship.<ref name="Rebel Strike" />

During the war against the Empire, Antilles was shot down over [[Tieos/Legends|Tieos]] and encountered a [[repulsorlift company]] of the [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]] on the<ref name="IH:ACG" /> planet.<ref name="Rebellion">[[Star Wars: Rebellion (video game)|''Star Wars: Rebellion'']]</ref>

When Calrissian's informants located Fett in the [[Cadavine Sector Fleet Imperial Enclave]] on [[Gall/Legends|Gall]], a moon of the planet [[Zhar/Legends|Zhar]], Skywalker called on Antilles to help him raid the Imperial installation. The Rogues quickly traveled to the system and set up a prefabricated base on [[Kile]], a moon opposite Gall. Calrissian's agent [[Dash Rendar/Legends|Dash Rendar]], a smuggler who had flown alongside the Rogues at Hoth, docked his freighter, the [[Outrider/Legends|''Outrider'']], in the simple hangar and quarters the Rogues maintained. Along with Rendar, the Rogues scouted the Imperial Enclave as they waited for Rendar to confirm Fett's presence, learning that two Star Destroyers guarded the base, with a TIE complement that outnumbered the Rogues by twelve to one.<ref name="Shadows of the Empire" />

When Rendar had ensured the bounty hunter was there, he sent a message to Calrissian that brought the searchers to Kile. Antilles was pleased to catch up with his friends, but they had to act before Fett left. Skywalker came up with a plan to tie up the entire Enclave's defenses with an attack by Rogue Squadron while Rendar led Calrissian, Chewbacca, and Organa, in the ''Millennium Falcon'', to Fett. Antilles was happy to yield command to Skywalker for the mission. Skywalker led the Rogues against the Star Destroyer orbiting the day side of the planet, stirring up a fierce dogfight. Scotian was sent back to base and Rogue Five [[Dix Rivan]] was killed in the [[Battle of Gall|battle]], and as the second Star Destroyer approached, Antilles suggested withdrawing. Skywalker insisted they give Calrissian one more minute before making a final strafing run against the Star Destroyer and returning to Kile. When they retreated, Janson's [[Unidentified R2 unit (Wes Janson)|R2 unit]] took control of his fighter and began firing on Skywalker. The Jedi was able to disable the craft's engines and targeting sensors, allowing Antilles to attach a grapple to Janson's ship and tow him back to base.<ref name="Shadows of the Empire" />

[[File:Viera_Cheran_and_Wedge.jpg|thumb|left|180px|Antilles speaks with Viera Cheran after the Battle of Gall.]]
As they landed, Antilles was relieved both his friends had survived. Analysis of Janson's [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech]] showed it had been programmed to fire on Skywalker, but the investigation got no farther as both Antilles and Skywalker departed to meet Rendar when he returned from guiding the ''Millennium Falcon''. Antilles had to calm down his commander as Rendar revealed he had abandoned the others once they found Fett's [[Slave I/Legends|''Slave I'']], having been paid only to guide, not fight. As they waited for the ''Millennium Falcon'', detected approaching but with its comm disabled, to land, they returned to Janson's astromech only to find it destroyed. [[Viera Cheran]], the Rogue crew chief, had shot it and now held a blaster on Skywalker. Antilles quickly drew his pistol and shot her. He went to check her history on the base [[Computer/Legends|computer]], and was aided by Calrissian when he arrived, empty-handed, as Fett had escaped. They found that Cheran had recently received payments that Calrissian tracked through several dummy corporations to a [[Saber Enterprises|known front]] for Imperial Intelligence [[Renik|operations]].<ref name="Shadows of the Empire" />

====A second Death Star====
{{Quote|I'm proud to say this is truly the first day of a New Republic, freed from the tyranny of the Empire forever. We're all gathered on the planet's surface. I can hear music and laughter drifting through the trees. I can't help but pause and take a long look at my friends: Luke, Han, the Princess, Lando, and all the other Rebels who fought long and hard in the trenches. Guys like me, guys just doing their job. And I can't help feeling&hellip;we're all heroes now.|Wedge Antilles|<ref name="Galactic Battlegrounds">''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds]]''</ref>}}
The team searching for Solo dispersed to other assignments, while the Rogues moved on from Kile with that mission's failure.<ref name="Shadows of the Empire" /> When the CR90 corvette [[Razor (CR90 corvette)|''Razor'']] was to [[Battle of Kothlis|rendezvous]] with the frigate ''Redemption'' over the planet [[Kothlis/Legends|Kothlis]] and relay vital information, the Rogues were assigned to cover the meeting. They arrived with the ''Redemption'' only to find the ''Razor'' being captured by the [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyer]] [[Motivator (Imperial-class)|''Motivator'']]. Antilles, in a B-wing, defended the ''Redemption'', then used the powerful fighter, designed to tackle capital ships, to disable the ''Motivator''. Out of control, the Star Destroyer plummeted to Kothlis's surface, necessitating a landing to recover the data from the ''Razor'', which was within the crashed ship. He transferred to an X-wing to escort Madine's commandos to the surface, then defended them from the ''Motivator''{{'s}} complement of AT-AT and AT-PT walkers, which were emerging from the ship's hulk. The commandos successfully recovered the data, which turned out to be the revelation that the [[Death Star II/Legends|Death Star II]] was being constructed over the [[Endor/Legends|Forest moon]] of the gas giant [[Endor (planet)/Legends|Endor]]. [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] had resurrected his weapon of terror in a greater and more powerful form.<ref name="Rogue Leader game" />

[[File:WedgeAntilles.jpg|thumb|right|180px|Antilles in the cockpit, 4 ABY]]
While the Rogues were with the main [[Alliance Fleet/Legends|Alliance Fleet]], a message drone from Rendar arrived, requesting that they travel to the Imperial capital world [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] and await his signal to provide assistance.<ref name="Shadows of the Empire Sourcebook" /> Skywalker and Calrissian had already traveled there in an attempt to rescue Organa from the clutches of Prince [[Xizor/Legends|Xizor]], the head of crime syndicate [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]], and had connected with Rendar and Chewbacca.<ref name="Shadows of the Empire" /> Knowing his comrades were on Coruscant, Antilles agreed to provide reinforcements, and took the Rogues to the center of the [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor's]] power, where they waited, hidden among droid-controlled barge traffic in the far reaches of [[Coruscant system/Legends|the system]].<ref name="Shadows of the Empire Sourcebook" />

The Rebel group was able to rescue Organa and escape into orbit, but the forces of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy's]] most powerful criminal syndicate remained arrayed against them.<ref name="Shadows of the Empire" /> Rendar sent his signal, and Antilles rushed to find his allies.<ref name="Shadows of the Empire Sourcebook" /> Locating the [[Battle over Coruscant|battle]], Antilles quickly began shooting Black Sun's fighters off the ''Millennium Falcon'' and the ''Outrider''. Badly outnumbered, neither Skywalker, Rendar, nor Antilles thought they would be able to escape. They feared the odds were even worse when Imperial fighters arrived, but the TIEs shocked Antilles by firing on Xizor's craft. Darth Vader was putting an end to his long-running feud with Xizor, and the Rebels were a secondary concern. When the ''Executor'' destroyed [[Falleen's Fist|Xizor's]] [[Skyhook/Legends|skyhook]], the Rebels rushed through its debris field to freedom, though Rendar was presumed lost in the process.<ref name="Shadows of the Empire" />

When Rebel pilot [[Ace Azzameen/Legends|Ace Azzameen]] and a commando team [[Mission to Zhar|captured]] the [[Lambda-class T-4a shuttle/Legends|''Lambda''-class shuttle]] [[Tydirium/Legends|''Tydirium'']] from [[Outpost 327]] in the [[Zhar system]] and came under attack before they could escape, the Rogues were summoned to cover the shuttle's retreat to the ''Liberty'', which they did successfully.<ref name="X-Wing Alliance">''[[Star Wars: X-Wing Alliance]]''</ref> Though the Rebels seized Imperial passcodes from the ship, it eventually fell back into Imperial hands.<ref name="Complete Cross-Sections">''[[Star Wars: Complete Cross-Sections]]''</ref> As Madine's plan to strike at the Death Star required infiltrating Endor with an Imperial shuttle so a unit of commandos could disable the Death Star's shield generator, they needed to steal the shuttle back. Antilles was tasked with acquiring ''Tydirium'' from the Imperial [[Imperial Naval Academy/Legends|Naval Academy]] on the planet [[Prefsbelt IV/Legends|Prefsbelt IV]]. Sneaking past the academy's sensor network, he subdued its defenses before taking off in ''Tydirium'', covered by his fellow Rogues. After that [[Mission to Prefsbelt IV|mission]], when vital supplies of tibanna gas for the fleet came under threat at Bespin, the Rogues came to their defense. Antilles [[Battle of Bespin (Galactic Civil War)|saved]] the [[tibanna gas platform]]s, then eliminated Imperial defenses on Cloud City to protect further platforms.<ref name="Rogue Leader game" />

[[File:Wedge-antilles-the-desolation-of-hoth-by_Baracchi.jpg|thumb|left|235px|Antilles and Ackbar during the briefing for the attack on the second Death Star]]
Antilles returned to the Rebel fleet massing over Sullust in preparation for the mission to destroy the Death Star II. He worked with Ackbar and Calrissian, who had received a general's commission, to plan the starfighter assault on the superweapon.<ref name="A Guide to the Star Wars Universe">''[[A Guide to the Star Wars Universe, Third Edition, Revised and Expanded]]''</ref> As the gargantuan station was not yet completed, starfighters would be able to fly into its [[Reactor/Legends|reactor core]] and directly deliver the crippling strike. Antilles was present at Ackbar and Madine's briefing on the mission, as were Organa, Calrissian, Chewbacca, Solo&mdash;newly freed from carbonite&mdash;and the late-arriving Skywalker. There Madine outlined his plan to sneak a team under Solo, now commissioned as a general, onto Endor to disable the shield generator there that protected the Death Star in advance of the Rebellion's naval attack. Rebel leader Mon Mothma informed the crowd that Palpatine himself would be aboard the station when they struck; a victory at Endor would mean a crippling blow against the Empire.<ref name="Return of the Jedi">{{Film|VI}}</ref>

Calrissian would command the fighters from the ''Millennium Falcon'' as Gold Leader.<ref name="Return of the Jedi" /> Antilles was placed in charge of Red Wing&mdash;named by Antilles in honor of the squadron that had vanquished the Death Star at Yavin 4&mdash;and would fly as Calrissian's wingman in the very same X-wing in which he had fought the first Death Star, tasked to make another Death Star run.<ref name="Galaxy Guide 5 Second Edition" /><ref name="Return of the Jedi" /><ref name="Return of the Jedi novel">[[Star Wars: Return of the Jedi (novelization)|''Star Wars Episode VI: Return of the Jedi'' novelization]]</ref><ref name="Death Star II Red Squadron 1">{{CCG|set=Death Star II Limited|cardname=Red Squadron 1}}</ref> Afterward, Antilles gave his own, more specific briefing to his pilots. He faced the traditional skepticism of Klivian but attempted to boost their confidence as they prepared to take on the enormous superweapon.<ref name="Galaxy Guide 5" />

Once they were prepared and believed Solo had brought the shields down, the fleet jumped to Endor. As they approached the space station, Calrissian and his co-pilot [[Nien Nunb/Legends|Nien Nunb]] realized that they were being [[Jammer/Legends|jammed]], and the space station's shields were still up; they had flown into Palpatine's trap. Antilles broke off on Calrissian's orders and with the rest of the fleet [[Battle of Endor/Legends|engaged]] the Imperial force, led by the ''Executor'', emerging from the other side of the Sanctuary Moon of Endor. When a wave of TIEs engaged, Antilles attempted to pull them away from the Rebel capital ships.<ref name="Return of the Jedi" /> He fiercely defended the medical frigate ''Redemption'' as it came under heavy attack, preserving the ship.<ref name="Rogue Leader game" /> The reason the enemy capital ships did not engage was revealed when the Death Star opened fire on the Rebel [[Cruiser/Legends|cruisers]], destroying the ''Liberty''. Only Calrissian's insistence on engaging the Imperial fleet point-blank, to keep the Death Star from firing, convinced Ackbar not to order a retreat.<ref name="Return of the Jedi" /> Antilles first made crippling runs against the bridges of a pair of Star Destroyers in the fore of the Imperial formation, protecting ''Home One''.<ref name="Rogue Leader game" /> Then, he, Calrissian, [[Blue Leader/Legends|Blue Leader]] [[Merrick Simms]], and [[Green Wing]] attacked the [[Pride of Tarlandia/Legends|main communications ship]] of the Imperial fleet. As Green Wing's sacrifice cleared the path, they were able to target the ship's reactors by flying within its cargo bay. The ship was destroyed, catching Simms in the blast.<ref name="Return of the Jedi novel" /> Antilles led Red Group well, preserving most of his pilots while they racked up a significant kill count.<ref name="Galaxy Guide 5" />

[[File:WedgeFires-ROTJHD.jpg|thumb|right|180px|Antilles fires on the Death Star II's power regulator.]]
When at last Solo's team destroyed the shield generator, Calrissian and Antilles led a squad of fighters across the Death Star's surface and then into an opening that gave them access to a series of narrow, deadly passages in the battle station's superstructure.<ref name="Rogue Leader game" /> Antilles was the first in, flying at high velocity through the constricted spaces as TIEs pursued the Rebel craft.<ref name="Return of the Jedi" /> Travel was further complicated when, moving at breakneck speed, the ships suddenly lost their instruments due to interference from the heavy-duty power sources nearby. Antilles had to fly dependent on his eyes and instincts, nearly blind at his speed.<ref name="Return of the Jedi novel" /> After [[Red Seven/Legends|Red Seven]] Keir Santage was killed by the TIE pursuit, Calrissian sent the others off to draw away the pursuit, leaving only Antilles and Calrissian to make the run with Imperial pursuers remaining on their tails. They emerged into the vast open chamber housing the reactor core, where the ''Millennium Falcon'' fired on the core itself,<ref name="Return of the Jedi" /> while Antilles targeted the [[Power regulator/Legends|power regulator]]<ref name="fbTIM">{{Facebook|username=StarWars.UK|url=photo.php?fbid=532092583509014&set=a.184244804960462.62918.169299103121699&type=1|name=Star Wars|date=March 20, 2013|quote=By flying into the core and taking out the power regulator, Wedge Antilles was partially responsible for the destruction of the second Death Star.|archivedate=20200819124159}}</ref> with a pair of proton torpedoes,<ref name="Return of the Jedi" /> being partially responsible for the destruction of the space station.<ref name="fbTIM" /> As the core collapsed, the pair flew the same treacherous route to safety with Antilles once more in the lead, escaping in his X-wing just before the second Death Star was consumed by a massive explosion.<ref name="Return of the Jedi" />

The battle did not end there, as the Imperial fleet fought on for just under four hours. With the Death Star, the ''Executor'', and the main communications ship destroyed, Imperial coordination was thrown into chaos, undermining the integrity of their defensive action. Only after long hours of fighting did the fleet retreat, giving the Rebels control of the battlefield. The Rebels began salvage and repair operations, their own fleet having sustained high casualties and heavy damage in the brutal fighting.<ref name="The Truce at Bakura Sourcebook" />

====New threats and the New Republic====
{{Quote|It's just that, after every major victory, I hope the fighting is over. But it'll never be over&hellip;Even after we defeat the Imperials, there will be someone&hellip;another threat to peace&hellip;''"<br />"''Sounds like you're handing me your resignation.''"<br />"''Actually, I'm trying to find a way to tell you I've never been more committed. We have to keep fighting so that others don't have to.|Wedge Antilles and Luke Skywalker|<ref name="Rogue Leader" />}}
After the battle had concluded, the Rebels held a victory celebration in [[Bright Tree Village/Legends|Bright Tree Village]] on the forest moon of Endor, the home of the native [[Ewok/Legends|Ewoks]] who had aided Solo's commando unit. Antilles was present, where he was overjoyed to see Skywalker had survived confronting Vader and Palpatine, who were both now dead, aboard the Death Star, and his friends on Solo's team alive as well. With the Empire dealt its greatest blow yet, the festivities went on well into the night as Antilles celebrated with his friends.<ref name="Return of the Jedi" />

In the wake of the Battle of Endor, the Alliance obtained a rare, pre-Yavin edition of the ''Imperial Handbook'', and distributed it amongst key personnel such as Antilles. He annotated the text with assessments of Imperial materiel and tactics, and discussed his personal experiences at Turkana and Tieos in addition to Rogue Squadron missions resulting in the destruction of an [[Orbital nightcloak]] superweapon, and that of an [[IM-S-653 Orbital Garrison]] over<ref name="IH:ACG" /> the planet<ref name="Demon">{{Tales|3|Deal with a Demon}}</ref> [[Ootoola]].<ref name="IH:ACG" />

[[File:WedgeTABSB.jpg|thumb|left|180px|Antilles intervenes to prevent the self-destruction of the message drone from Bakura.]]
The next day, Antilles returned to the fleet on the first shuttle and immediately began patrol duty.<ref name="The Truce at Bakura">''[[The Truce at Bakura]]''</ref> Outer-system patrols guarded against the threat of Imperial counterattack while near the fleet salvage action continued and fighters stood ready to counterattacks by Imperial survivors within the battle area. When an Imperial intrusion by the patrol craft ''[[Daggerblade]]'' disrupted the [[sensor net]], the Rogues were dispatched to secure the area and perform picket duty.<ref name="The Truce at Bakura Sourcebook" />

While patrolling, Antilles intercepted an Imperial [[Elegance message drone|message drone]] sent to Palpatine. Attempting to access its message, he accidentally triggered the drone's [[Self-destruct mechanism/Legends|self-destruct mechanism]]. Antilles quickly clambered from his starfighter in [[Vacuum/Legends|vacuum]] gear and thrust his hand between the [[electrite crystal]] leads of the self-destruct, knowing he had to stop them from making contact or the drone would explode, taking him and the nearby Alliance ships with it. As the mechanism crushed his hand and the fleet evacuated, Antilles remained in vacuum in tremendous pain. Skywalker rushed to the drone in his X-wing and, ejecting his lightsaber from the fighter, used [[Telekinesis/Legends|telekinesis]] and a Force link with Antilles to slice away the [[Crystal/Legends|crystals]] with the lightsaber just after Antilles leaped away. The Corellian passed out, but was quickly picked up by a [[Sprint-class rescue craft/Legends|med runner]] and, with all his fingers saved, put in a bacta tank to heal.<ref name="The Truce at Bakura" /> Afterward, he was left with a lingering wariness of zero-[[Gravity/Legends|gravity]] situations, tending to flash back to the event when in null gravity.<ref name="Wraith Squadron" />

While Antilles spent a day healing, Rebel technicians were able to decode the message. It was from remote Bakura and told of an [[Ssi-ruuvi invasions|invasion]] by strange attackers from the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]]. After persuasion from Organa and Solo, the Rebel leadership decided to send a fleet to counter the invasion and possibly gain Bakura's allegiance. With Organa as the negotiator and Solo escorting her, Madine thought to put Antilles in charge of the battle group, but when the [[Force ghost/Legends|spirit]] of Obi-Wan Kenobi told Skywalker he had to travel to Bakura and avert a dire threat, Skywalker was put in command.<ref name="The Truce at Bakura" />

The next day, recovered, Antilles and the Rogues departed as part of the strike force, stationed aboard the [[Carrier/Legends|carrier]] ''[[Flurry]]''. They arrived at Bakura to find its Imperial defense fleet [[Invasion of Bakura|engaged]] against the invaders&mdash;the [[Ssi-ruu]]k. The ranking Imperial officer, Commander [[Pter Thanas]], accepted Skywalker's offer of assistance. The Alliance fleet struck the center of the Ssi-ruuvi formation, destroying a cruiser and driving the Ssi-ruuk into retreat. While Skywalker, Solo, Organa, Chewbacca, and their droids landed to negotiate with [[Wilek Nereus]], the Imperial governor, the Rebel ships entered the Imperial defensive pattern, ready for a strike should the Ssi-ruuk return from the outer reaches of the [[Bakura system/Legends|system]]. They soon did so, setting up a blockade of the planet outside the range of the defense net.<ref name="The Truce at Bakura" />

When the Rebels and Imperials had prepared a coordinated attack, Skywalker apprised Antilles of it, but warned him to be on alert for treachery from Nereus. The Ssi-ruuk launched their own [[Bakura Incident|attack]] unexpectedly, which the combined forces were able to repel with the aid of Skywalker. Skywalker had been captured by the Ssi-ruuk with aid from Nereus and terrified the Ssi-ruuk into abandoning their flagship once he got free. Once the invaders retreated, though, Thanas opened fire on the Rebels under the treacherous governor's orders. Trapped, seemingly with no way out, the Rebels were suddenly able to escape when Skywalker used the captured [[Sibwarra|''Shriwirr'']] to draw Thanas's Carrack light cruiser, ''[[Dominant]]'', out of position. Antilles led his fighters to protect ''Shriwirr'' while the ''Millennium Falcon'' recovered Skywalker, who convinced Thanas to surrender as a Bakuran revolt swept Nereus from power. The Bakurans elected to join the Alliance, and Thanas supervised the disarmament and withdrawal of Imperial forces before defecting. Victorious, the fleet returned to Endor.<ref name="The Truce at Bakura" />

Antilles remained stationed on Endor's forest moon, where the Alliance had set up a base, [[Endor Station]].<ref name="Jawas of Doom">[[Star Wars (1977) 81|''Star Wars'' (1977) 81]]</ref> He volunteered for salvage duty, as efforts to recover both Rebel and Imperial wreckage and bodies continued. As Skywalker returned to active duty with the squadron and resumed command, Antilles was bumped to [[Rogue Two/Legends|Rogue Two]]. He began to hope that the Rebellion had earned victory and that he could soon retire from military service.<ref name="Rogue Leader" /> When Mothma and Ackbar declared a major meeting, Antilles rounded up Solo, Calrissian, and Chewbacca. At the meeting, many Alliance figures were dispatched to diplomatic missions recruiting representatives as the Alliance sought to legitimize itself by holding a deliberative congress free to all worlds and species.<ref name="The Hero" /> Heartened by the crucial defeat of the Empire at Endor, many worlds flocked to the Rebel banner. Approximately a week after the destruction of the second Death Star, the Alliance to Restore the Republic re-formed as the [[Alliance of Free Planets]], an interim government put in place to ease the transition to the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]].<ref name="The Truce at Bakura Sourcebook" />

At that time, Antilles was summoned from flying a salvaging Y-wing for a scouting mission commanded by Skywalker. With the Empire reeling, Rebel forces were being dispatched to reconnoiter major Imperial locations. Celchu, Janson, and new Blue Leader [[Ten Numb/Legends|Ten Numb]] were also along for the assignment, which was to assess the disposition of Antilles's home system. They spent a week searching the system for signs of the Empire, but it seemed that the Empire had withdrawn from control of Corellia. At the end of that week, they were in Coronet City and hoped to relax. They were at a [[Unidentified cantina (Coronet City)|cantina]], beginning a night on the town, when Imperial forces suddenly [[Raid at Coronet|struck]] in an attempt to terrorize the city. Under the command of storm commando General [[Weir/Legends|Weir]], a light assault force attempted to reassert Imperial dominance. The Rogue detachment held their attackers at bay, and Antilles managed to capture [[Weir's aide]] while Numb attempted to track the withdrawing Weir. Antilles, Skywalker, and Janson followed while Celchu went to retrieve their fighters. They were too late to catch Weir, who captured Numb and rushed into orbit.<ref name="Rogue Leader" />

[[File:Wedgepunchweir.jpg|thumb|right|200px|Antilles subdues Weir.]]
Celchu arrived with their astromech-piloted starfighters, allowing them to continue the pursuit. As they tracked Weir's craft through heavy civilian traffic, they were attacked by droid-piloted TIE fighters packed with explosives. The Rogues defeated the suicide drones, which attempted to menace civilians when they proved unable to slow the Rogues sufficiently. Weir escaped, but R2-D2 was able to track him and Numb to the planet [[Tralus/Legends|Tralus]], where they learned that stormtroopers had been using the [[Selonian/Legends|Selonian]] [[Selonian Tunnels|tunnel network]] as a base. Familiar with the natives of his own system, Antilles led negotiations with the Selonian leader [[Leyli]], who agreed to provide [[Scout/Legends|scouts]] who could lead the quartet to the [[Weir's base|hidden Imperial base]]. They stormed Weir's stronghold, where the panicky general ordered an evacuation. Antilles commandeered a TIE fighter to follow Weir, who was fleeing in an interceptor. Celchu shot down their pursuers while Antilles shot down Weir, landed, and beat the storm commando into submission as he crawled from his wrecked fighter. Though Numb had died after Weir's [[Torture/Legends|torture]], the general was brought to justice in Alliance custody.<ref name="Rogue Leader" />

Antilles returned to Endor, where he pondered the situation once more. He realized that victory would not come soon, and he could not shirk his commitment to the war against the Empire. Skywalker admitted to him that he was considering resigning soon to devote his efforts to restoring the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] and left it to Antilles to begin selecting replacement pilots for Rogue Squadron, which had found itself badly understaffed in the wake of Endor and Bakura.<ref name="Rogue Leader" />

At that time, another unexpected invasion plagued the Alliance of Free Planets: the strange and brutal [[Nagai/Legends|Nagai]], emigres from the satellite [[Galaxy/Legends|galaxy]] [[Firefist|Companion Besh]], began a campaign against the main galaxy in alliance with rogue Imperials. With their homeworld attacked by the Nagai, the [[Mandalorian Protectors (Spar)|Mandalorian Protectors]] under [[Mandalore (title)/Legends|Mandalore]] [[Fenn Shysa]] arrived on Endor to lend their strength to the war against the Nagai. During that time, Antilles was part of a fleet [[Mission to Godo|sent]] to the planet [[Godo]] on a mercy mission to alleviate the effects of a mysterious [[Godoan's disease|illness]] under which the [[Godoan/Legends|Godoans]] suffered. Han Solo, with the aid of R2-D2 and C-3PO, determined that their [[House of the Goddess]] was in fact a techno-organic machine designed to sustain life on Godo. It was missing two components&mdash;the statues known as the [[Dancing Goddess/Legends|Dancing Goddess]] and the [[Minstrel]], both formerly in Lando Calrissian's possession&mdash;and for that reason had ceased to function. They rushed to recover the statuary and replaced them, saving Godo. In his haste to reach Godo, however, Calrissian had not been inoculated against the Godoan disease, and on leaving the planet began to suffer its effects. The Godoans refused to allow Calrissian to return to their temple for treatment, insisting the Rebels could no longer trespass on sacred ground. Solo, furious at what he regarded as betrayal, threatened to assault the Godoan capital if Calrissian were not permitted healing. Ackbar strenuously objected, but Solo called for support among the fleet. Antilles pledged his commitment to disobey his superior officer, as did several more pilots, and the Godoans caved. Calrissian was saved, and Ackbar declined to impose consequences for Solo's bluff.<ref name="Touch of the Goddess">[[Star Wars (1977) 99|''Star Wars'' (1977) 99]]</ref>

[[File:WedgeNagaiBattle.jpg|thumb|left|180px|Antilles flies against the Nagai over Endor.]]
After that mission, the Alliance instituted a program to establish standards in its piloting corps at Calrissian's suggestion, forcing pilots to pass a simulated scenario in order to retain flight privileges. Antilles passed, but Skywalker and Solo were grounded, as their unconventional flight styles fell outside the testing computer's parameters. When an armada presumed to be Nagai appeared over Endor, Antilles was sent up under Calrissian's command, but Solo and Skywalker remained on the ground as the Alliance prepared to evacuate the forest moon of Endor. They had been betrayed, however, by [[Bey]]&mdash;a friend of Solo and secret half-Nagai&mdash;and the enemy had copies of their new formations and maneuvers. To counter this, Calrissian ordered complex, unorthodox flight patterns borrowed from the grounded Solo's repertoire that allowed Antilles and his fellow pilots to [[Second Battle of Endor|defeat]] the Nagai attack and cover the evacuation.<ref name="First Strike">[[Star Wars (1977) 100|''Star Wars'' (1977) 100]]</ref>

In the wake of the evacuation of the forest moon of Endor, the [[Tof/Legends|Tofs]], mortal enemies of the Nagai, emerged as an even greater threat. Having hounded the Nagai from Companion Besh, they now invaded the main galaxy. The Alliance was forced to unite with the Nagai to defeat the Tofs, and launched a months-long [[Nagai–Tof War|campaign]] to root out the invaders.<ref name="The Forgotten War">{{Hyperspace|url=fans/hyperspace/source/nagai11202009/index.html|text=The Forgotten War: The Nagai and the Tofs|int=The Forgotten War: The Nagai and the Tofs}}</ref> A month after the Alliance of Free Planets was formed, the [[New Republic Provisional Council|Provisional Council]] declared the New Republic and completed the transition from revolutionary insurgency to full interplanetary government.<ref name="The Truce at Bakura Sourcebook" /> Weeks after the Battle of Endor, Antilles was involved in a [[Skirmish above a luminous lake|mission]] in which his fighter was badly damaged by clipping a TIE fighter in the utter darkness of a cloudy night sky. With his engines and instruments disabled, he plummeted with no way to tell where he was or what was in his way.
